meta.title: 少词多用 · 日常英语听说
meta.description: 用尽量少的词汇表达各种意思，达到能与英国人日常交流的水平

scenes.title: 超市
scenes.description: 在英国超市从找货、挑选、问优惠到结账的真实交流

patterns.sentence: Could you tell me where ___ is?
patterns.note: 比 Where is 更礼貌、更地道，英国超市问路首选。
一个句型问遍各种信息，后面接完整句子即可。
be after 是英式口语里「想找某物」的地道说法。
做决定时比 I want 更自然，表示「我选这个」。
礼貌索要任何东西，比 Can I have 更客气。
英式含蓄表达不满，加 a bit 语气更委婉得体。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you point me towards the frozen section?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，您能指给我冷冻区在哪边吗？
dialogue.tip: point me towards 是问方向的地道说法，比 Where is 更自然礼貌。

alternatives.text: Could you tell me where the frozen section is?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, it's just past the bakery, on your left.
dialogue.translation: 当然，过了面包区就是，在你左手边。
dialogue.tip: just past 表示「刚过……」，指路高频表达。

alternatives.text: It's right after the bakery.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, thanks. Actually, do you know if they stock oat milk there?
dialogue.translation: 太好了，谢谢。对了，您知道那儿有燕麦奶吗？
dialogue.tip: do you know if 是询问信息的高级句型，后面接完整句子。

alternatives.text: Do they sell oat milk there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They do, but it's usually on the shelf above the soy milk.
dialogue.translation: 有的，不过通常放在豆奶上面的货架上。
dialogue.tip: They do 是 They do stock it 的省略，口语很常见。

alternatives.text: Yes, it's on the shelf above the soy milk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm also after some decent cheddar — any recommendations?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。我还想买点像样的切达奶酪——有什么推荐吗？
dialogue.tip: be after 表示「在找某物」，any recommendations 是请人推荐的常用语。

alternatives.text: I'm looking for some good cheddar. Any suggestions?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: The mature one over there's rather good, and it's on offer at the moment.
dialogue.translation: 那边那款熟成的相当不错，而且现在正在打折。
dialogue.tip: rather good 是英式含蓄赞美；on offer 表示「打折促销」。

alternatives.text: The mature one's quite good and it's on special now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I'll have a look. By the way, is that reduction on all cheese or just this one?
dialogue.translation: 哦，我看看。对了，那个折扣是所有奶酪都有还是只有这款？
dialogue.tip: by the way 转换话题；reduction 指降价，是英式常用词。

alternatives.text: Does the discount apply to all cheese?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just the selected lines — the sign should say.
dialogue.translation: 只有指定产品——标牌上应该有写。
dialogue.tip: selected lines 指「指定的几款商品」，购物常用表达。

alternatives.text: Only certain ones — check the sign.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, I see it now. Cheers.
dialogue.translation: 好，我看到了。谢谢。
dialogue.tip: Cheers 是英式最常用的「谢谢」，朋友和店员之间都很自然。

alternatives.text: Right, got it. Thanks a lot.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No worries.
dialogue.translation: 不客气。
dialogue.tip: No worries 是英式「没关系/不客气」，比 You're welcome 更口语。

alternatives.text: Not a problem.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: These avocados look a bit firm — how long do they take to ripen?
dialogue.translation: 这些牛油果看着有点硬——要多久才能熟？
dialogue.tip: a bit firm 是英式委婉说法；how long do they take to... 问「要多久才……」。

alternatives.text: How long until these avocados are ripe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A couple of days at room temperature, or pop them in a paper bag.
dialogue.translation: 室温下放两天，或者装进纸袋里。
dialogue.tip: pop them in 是「随手放进去」的地道口语说法。

alternatives.text: Leave them out for a couple of days.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good to know. I'll take four, please. Could you weigh them for me?
dialogue.translation: 知道了。我要四个。能帮我称一下吗？
dialogue.tip: Good to know 表示「记住了」；weigh 是「称重」。

alternatives.text: Four, please. Could you weigh them?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Anything else?
dialogue.translation: 当然。还需要别的吗？
dialogue.tip: Anything else 是店员询问是否还需要别的的固定用语。

alternatives.text: Sure. Anything else I can get you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes — whereabouts are the eggs? I can't seem to find them.
dialogue.translation: 是的——鸡蛋在哪儿？我好像找不到。
dialogue.tip: whereabouts 是「在哪里」的英式说法；I can't seem to 是委婉表达「我似乎没法……」。

alternatives.text: Where are the eggs? I can't find them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Near the dairy, next to the butter. They've moved them recently.
dialogue.translation: 在乳制品区附近，黄油旁边。他们最近挪了位置。
dialogue.tip: They've moved them 是现在完成时，表示「他们（把货）挪了」。

alternatives.text: By the dairy, beside the butter.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ah, that explains it. Are these free-range, by the way?
dialogue.translation: 啊，难怪。对了，这些是散养的吗？
dialogue.tip: That explains it 表示「这就说得通了」；free-range 指「散养的」。

alternatives.text: Oh, that's why. Are these free-range eggs?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They are, yes. These ones are organic as well.
dialogue.translation: 是的。而且这些是有机的。
dialogue.tip: as well 放在句尾表示「也」，比 also 更口语。

alternatives.text: Yes, they are. And they're organic too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll go for the organic then. How much are they?
dialogue.translation: 那我要有机的吧。多少钱？
dialogue.tip: go for 表示「选择」；how much are they 问复数商品价格。

alternatives.text: I'll take the organic ones. How much?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Two pounds twenty for a dozen.
dialogue.translation: 一打两英镑二十。
dialogue.tip: 英国用英镑（pound）；a dozen 是「一打（12个）」。

alternatives.text: That's £2.20 for twelve.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's reasonable. I'll take a dozen.
dialogue.translation: 价格合理。我要一打。
dialogue.tip: reasonable 表示「合理的、公道的」，评价价格常用。

alternatives.text: That's a fair price. I'll have a dozen.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right, that comes to eighteen pounds fifty. Cash or card?
dialogue.translation: 好，一共十八英镑五十。现金还是刷卡？
dialogue.tip: comes to 表示「总计为」；Cash or card 是结账必问句。

alternatives.text: That's £18.50 altogether. Cash or card?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Card, please. Actually, I've got a loyalty card — does that give me anything off?
dialogue.translation: 刷卡。对了，我有会员卡——能打折吗？
dialogue.tip: loyalty card 是超市会员卡；anything off 指「能减多少钱」。

alternatives.text: Card. Do I get a discount with my loyalty card?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It does actually. You've got a couple of points, so that's seventy pence off.
dialogue.translation: 确实可以。您有几个积分，所以减七十便士。
dialogue.tip: points 指会员积分；pence 是便士（penny 的复数）。

alternatives.text: Yes, you've got some points, so 70p off.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice one. Oh, and could I get a bag? I forgot to bring one.
dialogue.translation: 太好了。哦，能给我个袋子吗？我忘带了。
dialogue.tip: Nice one 是英式「太好了」；forget to do 表示「忘记去做某事」。

alternatives.text: Great. Could I have a bag, please? I didn't bring one.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, that's five pence.
dialogue.translation: 可以，五便士。
dialogue.tip: 英国超市购物袋通常收费，环保政策所致。

alternatives.text: Of course, it's 5p.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here you go. Do you take contactless?
dialogue.translation: 给你。支持非接触支付吗？
dialogue.tip: contactless 指刷卡/手机「挥一下」支付，英国非常普遍。

alternatives.text: Here. Can I tap it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We do, just tap it there. And here's your receipt.
dialogue.translation: 支持的，在那里刷一下就行。这是您的小票。
dialogue.tip: tap 指「轻触刷卡」；receipt 里 p 不发音，读作 /rɪˈsiːt/。

alternatives.text: Yes, just tap your card. Here's your receipt.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot. Have a good one!
dialogue.translation: 非常感谢。祝你愉快！
dialogue.tip: Have a good one 是英式常见道别语，相当于「祝你有美好的一天」。

alternatives.text: Cheers. Have a nice day!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You too. Take care!
dialogue.translation: 你也是，保重！
dialogue.tip: Take care 是温暖的道别语，英国人常用。

alternatives.text: You too. Bye!

exercises.question: 你想礼貌地问冷冻区在哪儿，最合适的说法是？
options: Could you point me towards the frozen section?
exercises.explanation: Could you point me towards... 是礼貌又地道的问路方式。

exercises.question: 店员说 "It's on offer"，意思是？
exercises.explanation: on offer 是英式说法，表示商品正在打折促销。

exercises.question: "I'm after some decent cheddar" 中 be after 的意思是？
exercises.explanation: be after 在英式口语里表示「想找某物」。

exercises.question: 结账时店员问 "Cash or card?"，你想刷卡且支持挥卡，应说？
exercises.explanation: contactless 是非接触支付，英国超市普遍支持。

scenes.title: 购物
scenes.description: 在英国服装店从找衣服、问尺码颜色、试穿问价到挑礼物、付款退换的真实交流

patterns.note: be after 是英式口语里「想要、在找」的说法，比 I want 委婉自然，一个句型走遍全场。
问尺码、颜色、款式的万能句，把空格一换就能反复用，店员一听就懂。
try on 是试穿的固定搭配，代词放中间（try it on），礼貌又地道。
英式表达讲究委婉，a bit 加上形容词就能温和地提出意见，不伤和气。
go for 表示「决定选择」，做购买决定时比 I want 更自然有分寸。
pay by 后直接接支付方式，英国店里拍卡、刷卡、现金都通用这一句。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Morning! I'm after a warm jumper for the autumn.
dialogue.translation: 早上好！我想找一件秋天穿的暖和毛衣。
dialogue.tip: be after 是英式口语里「想要、在找」的地道说法，比 I want 更自然委婉。

alternatives.text: Hi, I'm looking for a warm jumper.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lovely, we've got a few new ones in this week.
dialogue.translation: 好呀，这周我们进了几件新品。
dialogue.tip: lovely 在英国人日常对话里几乎万能，表示「很好、真棒」，语气热情。

alternatives.text: Great, we've had some new stock come in this week.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Is there anything in the sale at the moment?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。现在有什么打折的吗？
dialogue.tip: 英国说「打折促销」用 in the sale 或 on sale，不说 discount activity。

alternatives.text: Is anything reduced at the moment?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, quite a lot — that cable knit is half price.
dialogue.translation: 有的，还不少——那件麻花针织衫半价。
dialogue.tip: quite 在英式英语里常修饰形容词表「相当」；half price 是「半价」的固定说法。

alternatives.text: That cable knit is reduced by fifty percent.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ooh, that's decent. Does it come in other colours?
dialogue.translation: 哦，那件挺不错。别的颜色有吗？
dialogue.tip: come in 表示「有某种颜色或尺码供应」，是购物场景的高频短语动词。

alternatives.text: Does it come in any other colours?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It does — navy, beige and this rather nice burgundy.
dialogue.translation: 有的——藏青、米色，还有这个挺好看的酒红色。
dialogue.tip: rather nice 是典型的英式含蓄赞美，比 very nice 更地道有分寸。

alternatives.text: We've got navy, beige and burgundy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Navy sounds good. Do you have it in a medium?
dialogue.translation: 藏青色听起来不错。有中号吗？
dialogue.tip: Do you have it in a...? 是问尺码或颜色的万能句型，购物必备。

alternatives.text: Have you got it in a medium?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check — yes, we've got a medium out back.
dialogue.translation: 我查一下——有的，后面库房有中号。
dialogue.tip: out back 是英式口语「在后面、在库房里」，比 in the warehouse 更日常。

alternatives.text: Let me see — yes, we have one in the stockroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant. Where are the fitting rooms, please?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。请问试衣间在哪儿？
dialogue.tip: 英国叫试衣间 fitting room 或 changing room，一般不说 dressing room。

alternatives.text: Where can I try it on, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just over there, past the till — help yourself.
dialogue.translation: 就在那边，过了收银台——您自己去就行。
dialogue.tip: help yourself 在这里表示「自己去看、随意」，是店员常用的客气话。

alternatives.text: It's over there, just beyond the counter.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. Hmm, it's a bit tight across the shoulders.
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。嗯，肩膀这里有点紧。
dialogue.tip: a bit tight 是英式委婉表达，直接说 too small 会显得生硬。

alternatives.text: It feels a little tight on the shoulders.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Shall I fetch you a size up to try?
dialogue.translation: 要不要我去给您拿个大一号试试？
dialogue.tip: Shall I...? 是主动提供帮助的经典英式提议句型。

alternatives.text: Would you like me to get a larger size?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's spot on. How much is it?
dialogue.translation: 完美，这件正合适。多少钱？
dialogue.tip: spot on 是英式口语「恰到好处、完全正确」，夸衣服合身特别地道。

alternatives.text: That fits perfectly. What's the price?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's forty-five, but it's down from sixty.
dialogue.translation: 四十五镑，不过是从六十镑降下来的。
dialogue.tip: be down from 表示「从原价降到」，是英国商店说降价时的常用表达。

alternatives.text: It was sixty, now it's forty-five.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's reasonable. Could I try the navy one as well?
dialogue.translation: 挺公道的。我也能试试藏青色那件吗？
dialogue.tip: as well 放在句尾表示「也」，比 too 稍正式，英式对话里很常见。

alternatives.text: Could I also try the navy one?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course — I'll pop and grab it for you.
dialogue.translation: 当然——我这就去帮您拿过来。
dialogue.tip: pop 是英式万能轻动词，pop and grab 表示「快速去拿一下」，非常口语。

alternatives.text: Sure, I'll go and get it for you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheers. Actually, I'm also after a little present.
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。其实我还想买个小礼物。
dialogue.tip: cheers 是英国人最常用的「谢谢」，轻松随意；present 与 gift 同义。

alternatives.text: Thanks. I'm also looking for a small gift.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A present? Any idea what they're into?
dialogue.translation: 礼物？知道对方喜欢什么吗？
dialogue.tip: be into something 是口语「喜欢、对……感兴趣」，问对方喜好很自然。

alternatives.text: Do you know what they like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's for my sister — she loves a good scarf.
dialogue.translation: 是给我姐姐的——她特别喜欢好看的围巾。
dialogue.tip: a good scarf 里的 good 表示「像样的、好看的」，是英式口语常见用法。

alternatives.text: It's for my sister — she adores scarves.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: How about this one? It's pure wool, made in Scotland.
dialogue.translation: 这条怎么样？纯羊毛的，苏格兰制造。
dialogue.tip: How about...? 是提建议的常用句型；made in Scotland 是常见的品质卖点。

alternatives.text: What about this one? It's made of pure wool.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's lovely. I'll go for that and the jumper.
dialogue.translation: 真好看。那条围巾和毛衣我都要了。
dialogue.tip: I'll go for... 表示「我决定选……」，做购买决定时比 I want 更自然有分寸。

alternatives.text: I'll take that and the jumper.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Would you like it gift-wrapped with a gift receipt?
dialogue.translation: 好的。需要礼品包装并附礼品收据吗？
dialogue.tip: gift receipt 是不含价格的收据，方便对方换货，英国人送礼很讲究这一点。

alternatives.text: Do you want it wrapped as a gift?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, please — just in case the size is wrong.
dialogue.translation: 要的，谢谢——以防万一尺码不合适。
dialogue.tip: just in case 表示「以防万一」，后面接一般现在时，是高频口语短语。

alternatives.text: Yes, please — in case it doesn't fit.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No problem. You've got twenty-eight days to return it.
dialogue.translation: 没问题。您有二十八天的时间可以退货。
dialogue.tip: 英国实体店普遍有至少二十八天退换期，return 在这里作动词表示「退货」。

alternatives.text: You can return it within twenty-eight days.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And could I swap it if it doesn't fit?
dialogue.translation: 那如果不合身我可以换吗？
dialogue.tip: swap 是口语「调换、交换」，比 exchange 更随意自然。

alternatives.text: Could I exchange it if it doesn't fit?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely, as long as you've got your receipt.
dialogue.translation: 当然可以，只要您带着收据就行。
dialogue.tip: as long as 引导条件「只要」；注意 receipt 里 p 不发音，读作 /rɪˈsiːt/。

alternatives.text: Of course, provided you have your receipt.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant. Can I pay by contactless, please?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。请问可以刷非接触卡吗？
dialogue.tip: 英国几乎处处支持 contactless 拍卡付款，pay by 后面直接接支付方式。

alternatives.text: Can I tap my card, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course — just tap your card there. Thank you.
dialogue.translation: 当然——在那儿刷一下卡就行。谢谢。
dialogue.tip: tap your card 是「拍卡付款」的固定说法，英式英语里 tap 比 swipe 更常用。

alternatives.text: Just hold your card against the reader.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheers for your help. Really appreciate it.
dialogue.translation: 谢谢你的帮忙，真的很感激。
dialogue.tip: really appreciate it 是表达感谢的进阶说法，比单纯 thanks 更有分量。

alternatives.text: Thanks so much for your help.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No worries — have a lovely evening!
dialogue.translation: 不客气——祝您晚上愉快！
dialogue.tip: No worries 是英式回应感谢的轻松说法，相当于「没事儿、别客气」。

alternatives.text: Not at all — enjoy your evening!

exercises.question: 在句子 I'm after a warm jumper. 里，be after 是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: be after 是英式口语固定搭配，表示「想要、正在寻找」，比 I want 更委婉自然。

exercises.question: 想问店员「这件有中号吗」，最地道说法是？
options: Do you have this in a medium?
exercises.explanation: Do you have it in a...? 是问尺码或颜色的万能句型，语法完整又地道。

exercises.question: 试穿后觉得肩膀有点紧，最符合英式委婉表达的是？
options: It's a bit tight across the shoulders.
exercises.explanation: a bit tight 用 a bit 弱化批评，是英式表达里典型的委婉说法，不显得生硬。

exercises.question: 店员说 You've got twenty-eight days to return it. 意思是？
options: 你有 28 天时间可以退货
你必须在 28 天内付款
exercises.explanation: return 作动词表示「退货」，整句说明商店的 28 天退换货政策。

scenes.title: 旅行
scenes.description: 在英国小城从行程咨询、景点推荐、交通卡、当地习俗到拍照买纪念品的真实交流

patterns.meaning: 您建议我去……／从哪儿开始？
patterns.note: would suggest 比 should I 更委婉得体，问行程安排时先说这句准没错。
一个句型问遍所有开放和营业时间，后面直接接完整句子即可。
get 在这里等于 buy，比 I want 客气得多，买票问询通用。

patterns.sentence: Is it the done thing to ___?
patterns.note: the done thing 是英式「惯例、规矩」，问当地习俗最地道的一句。

patterns.sentence: Could you take a photo of ___?
slots: us in front of the cathedral
patterns.note: 请路人帮忙拍照的标准礼貌句型，of 后面换对象就能反复用。
be after 是英式口语里「想找某物」的说法，一个短语走遍旅行各种需求。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I've just got into town — where would you suggest I start?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，我刚到城里——您建议我从哪儿开始逛？
dialogue.tip: get into town 是英式「进城、到城里」的地道说法；where would you suggest 比 where should 更委婉。

alternatives.text: Hi, I've just arrived. Where do you recommend I begin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the cathedral's the obvious place, but the riverside's lovely too.
dialogue.translation: 嗯，大教堂当然是首选，不过河边也很漂亮。
dialogue.tip: the obvious place 指「最经典的去处」；lovely 是英式高频夸词，什么都能夸。

alternatives.text: The cathedral's a must, and the riverside is nice as well.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds good. How far is it from here, roughly?
dialogue.translation: 听起来不错。大概离这儿有多远？
dialogue.tip: roughly 放在句尾表示「大约、大概」，是英式口语很自然的用法。

alternatives.text: Sounds good. About how far is it from here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ten minutes on foot, or you could hop on a bus.
dialogue.translation: 走路十分钟，或者你可以搭公交去。
dialogue.tip: on foot 表示「步行」；hop on a bus 是「随手搭上公交」的地道口语说法。

alternatives.text: It's a ten-minute walk, or you can take the bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think I'll walk it. Do you know what time the cathedral opens?
dialogue.translation: 我想走过去吧。您知道大教堂几点开门吗？
dialogue.tip: walk it 在口语里表示「走路过去」；Do you know what time... 是问时间的礼貌句型。

alternatives.text: I'll walk, thanks. Any idea when the cathedral opens?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It opens at nine, but it closes early on Sundays — half past four.
dialogue.translation: 九点开门，不过周日关得早——四点半。
dialogue.tip: half past four 是英式读时间的方式，表示「四点半」；on Sundays 指「每逢周日」。

alternatives.text: Nine o'clock, but on Sundays it shuts at four thirty.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, that's handy. Is there a ticket I could get for the whole day?
dialogue.translation: 好，那倒方便。有没有能用一整天的票？
dialogue.tip: that's handy 表示「那挺方便的」；for the whole day 指「全天」，问票常用。

alternatives.text: Good to know. Is there a day ticket I can buy?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There is — a day rover covers all the buses in the city.
dialogue.translation: 有的——一日通票可以坐遍全城的公交。
dialogue.tip: day rover 是英国常见的「一日通票」；cover 在这里表示「涵盖、通用」。

alternatives.text: Yes, a day ticket covers unlimited bus travel.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could I get one of those at the machine over there?
dialogue.translation: 我能在那边那台机器上买一张吗？
dialogue.tip: Could I get one of those... 是购买时的礼貌句型；machine 在这里指售票机。

alternatives.text: Can I buy one from that machine over there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can, but it's cheaper at the newsagent's on the corner.
dialogue.translation: 可以，不过街角那家小商店更便宜。
dialogue.tip: newsagent's 是英式「报刊亭、小商店」；on the corner 指「在街角」。

alternatives.text: Yes, but the shop on the corner sells them cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheers, I'll pop in there on my way. Anything I should watch out for?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢，我顺路进去一趟。有什么要留意的吗？
dialogue.tip: pop in 是「顺便进去一下」；watch out for 表示「留意、当心」。

alternatives.text: Thanks, I'll drop in there. Anything to be aware of?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just mind the gap on the platform, and queues here are sacred.
dialogue.translation: 当心站台间隙就好，还有这儿的排队可是神圣不可侵犯的。
dialogue.tip: mind the gap 是英国地铁著名提示语；queues are sacred 幽默地说英国人极爱排队。

alternatives.text: Watch the platform edge, and always join the back of the queue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Noted. Is it the done thing to tip in restaurants here?
dialogue.translation: 记住了。在这儿下馆子给小费是惯例吗？
dialogue.tip: Noted 是「记下了」；the done thing 是英式「惯例、规矩」，问习俗很地道。

alternatives.text: Got it. Do people usually leave a tip in restaurants?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Only if the service is good — ten per cent's plenty, and it's often included.
dialogue.translation: 只有服务好才给——百分之十就够了，而且常常已经包含在账单里。
dialogue.tip: Only if 表示「只有在……时才」；per cent 读作 /pə ˈsent/，注意重音在后。

alternatives.text: If service isn't included, around ten per cent is fine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good to know. Now, could you take a photo of me by the river?
dialogue.translation: 知道了。对了，您能帮我在河边拍张照吗？
dialogue.tip: take a photo of... 是请人拍照的常用语；by the river 表示「在河边」。

alternatives.text: Could you snap me here with the river behind me?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course — just stand a bit closer to the railing.
dialogue.translation: 当然——你稍微靠近栏杆站一点就行。
dialogue.tip: Of course 是爽快答应；a bit closer 是英式委婉的「稍微近一点」。

alternatives.text: Sure — move in a little closer to the rail, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's lovely, thanks. Would you like me to take one of you?
dialogue.translation: 太好了，谢谢。要不要我也帮您拍一张？
dialogue.tip: That's lovely 是英式夸赞；Would you like me to... 是礼貌提议的句型。

alternatives.text: That's great, cheers. Shall I take one of you too?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's kind of you, but I'm working — the light's better over there, by the way.
dialogue.translation: 你真贴心，不过我在上班——对了，那边光线更好。
dialogue.tip: That's kind of you 是委婉谢绝；by the way 用来转换、补充话题。

alternatives.text: Thanks, but I'm on duty. The light's nicer on that side.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll have a look. What's that building with the clock tower?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢，我去看看。那座带钟楼的建筑是什么？
dialogue.tip: have a look 是「去看一看」；clock tower 指「钟楼」。

alternatives.text: I'll check it out. What's the building with the clock tower?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the old guildhall — it's not open to the public, mind.
dialogue.translation: 那是老市政厅——不过它不对公众开放哦。
dialogue.tip: guildhall 指「市政厅、行会大厅」；mind 放句尾是英式「注意、当心」。

alternatives.text: That's the guildhall. It isn't open to visitors, though.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ah, fair enough. Is there anywhere decent for a cream tea nearby?
dialogue.translation: 啊，行吧。附近有能喝奶油下午茶的好地方吗？
dialogue.tip: fair enough 是英式「行吧、有道理」；cream tea 是英国特色的奶油下午茶。

alternatives.text: Right, no problem. Where can I get a decent cream tea?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There's a tearoom just off the square — their scones are rather good.
dialogue.translation: 广场旁边有家茶室——他们的司康饼相当不错。
dialogue.tip: tearoom 是英式「茶室」；rather good 是英式含蓄赞美，比 very good 更地道。

alternatives.text: Try the tearoom near the square — the scones are lovely.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll give it a go. Do they take card, or is it cash only?
dialogue.translation: 我去试试。他们刷卡吗，还是只收现金？
dialogue.tip: give it a go 是「试一试」；cash only 指「只收现金」，问支付方式常用。

alternatives.text: I'll try it. Do they accept cards, or just cash?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They take card, but a lot of small places here prefer cash.
dialogue.translation: 可以刷卡，不过这儿很多小店更喜欢收现金。
dialogue.tip: a lot of 表示「很多」；prefer 是「更喜欢」，比 like 更准确地表达偏好。

alternatives.text: Cards are fine, though many small shops here like cash.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good to know. Lastly, I'm after a souvenir — something typically British.
dialogue.translation: 知道了。最后，我想买个纪念品——典型英式的那种。
dialogue.tip: lastly 用于收尾话题；be after 表示「想找」；typically British 指「典型英式的」。

alternatives.text: One more thing — I'd like a souvenir, something quintessentially British.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: The gift shop's got lovely tea towels and little porcelain boxes.
dialogue.translation: 礼品店有很漂亮的茶巾和小瓷盒。
dialogue.tip: tea towel 是英式「茶巾、擦碗布」；porcelain 读作 /ˈpɔːsəlɪn/，注意重音在前。

alternatives.text: They've got nice tea towels and small porcelain boxes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A tea towel sounds practical. How much is the one with the red phone box?
dialogue.translation: 茶巾听起来挺实用。印着红色电话亭的那条多少钱？
dialogue.tip: sounds practical 表示「听起来实用」；red phone box 是英国经典文化符号。

alternatives.text: I'll go for a tea towel. How much is the red phone box one?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Four pounds fifty, and you can get three for ten.
dialogue.translation: 四英镑五十，而且十英镑可以买三条。
dialogue.tip: three for ten 是英式「十镑三件」的促销说法；英镑读作 pound。

alternatives.text: £4.50 each, or three for a tenner.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll take one then. Thanks ever so much for all your help.
dialogue.translation: 那我买一条。非常感谢您的所有帮助。
dialogue.tip: ever so much 是英式「非常」，比 very much 更地道；take 在这里表示「买下」。

alternatives.text: I'll have one, thanks a lot for all your help.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: My pleasure — enjoy your stay, and do pop back if you need anything.
dialogue.translation: 我的荣幸——祝您玩得开心，有需要尽管再来找我。
dialogue.tip: My pleasure 回应感谢；pop back 是「再回来一趟」的地道说法，do 起强调作用。

alternatives.text: No problem at all. Enjoy your visit and come back anytime.

exercises.question: 你想礼貌地请对方推荐从哪儿开始游览，最合适的说法是？
options: Where would you suggest I start?
exercises.explanation: Where would you suggest I start? 用 would suggest 委婉又地道，是请教行程安排的首选。

exercises.question: 对方说大教堂 half past four 关门，指的是几点？
exercises.explanation: half past four 是英式读法，表示「四点半」，即四点三十。

exercises.question: 英式表达 the done thing 的意思是？
exercises.explanation: the done thing 指社会公认的「惯例、规矩」，常用来询问当地习俗。

exercises.question: 别人帮了你，想用地道英式英语说「非常感谢」，最合适的是？
options: Thank you so very much indeed.
exercises.explanation: ever so much 是英式加强语气的地道说法，比 very much 更自然。

scenes.title: 租车租房子
scenes.description: 在英国租车询价、买保险、验驾照、取还车，以及看房、谈租金押金、看家具设施到签约的真实交流

patterns.sentence: Could you tell me a bit about ___?
patterns.note: 礼貌询问信息的万能开头，加 a bit 语气更委婉自然，租车看房都能用。
后面直接接完整句子，一个句型问遍各种信息，比直接追问客气得多。
be after 是英式口语里「想找某物」的地道说法，比 I want 委婉。
come with 表示「附带」，问保险、设施、配置都好用，少词多用。
做决定时比 I want 更自然，表示「我选这个」，语气轻松。
英式含蓄表达不满，加 a bit 语气更委婉得体，谈价必备。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi there, could you tell me a bit about hiring a car for a few days?
dialogue.translation: 您好，能给我讲讲租几天车的情况吗？
dialogue.tip: could you tell me a bit about 是礼貌询问信息的万能开头；hire a car 是英式说法租车，美式多用 rent。

alternatives.text: Hello, what do you charge for a few days' hire?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. What size were you after, and how long did you have in mind?
dialogue.translation: 当然。您想要多大的车，心里想租多久？
dialogue.tip: be after 表示「想要／在找」；have in mind 指「心里打算」，都是地道口语。

alternatives.text: Sure. What kind of car and for how long?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Something small would do — just me and a suitcase. Say, Friday to Monday.
dialogue.translation: 小车就行——就我和一个行李箱。就说周五到周一吧。
dialogue.tip: would do 表示「……就行／足够」；say 用于提出大概时间，口语很常见。

alternatives.text: A small one's fine. From Friday to Monday, please.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right, the compact's forty-five a day, and that includes insurance.
dialogue.translation: 好的，小型车一天四十五镑，而且含保险。
dialogue.tip: compact 指「小型车」；a day 这里省略了 per；includes 表示「包含」。

alternatives.text: The small one is £45 a day, insurance included.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does it come with fully comprehensive cover, or just third party?
dialogue.translation: 是全险，还是只有第三方责任险？
dialogue.tip: come with 表示「附带／配有」；fully comprehensive 是全险；third party 是第三方责任险。

alternatives.text: What kind of insurance is included?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Fully comprehensive, but there's a five-hundred-pound excess if anything happens.
dialogue.translation: 是全险，不过万一出事有五百镑的免赔额。
dialogue.tip: excess 指保险「免赔额」；if anything happens 委婉地说「万一出事故」。

alternatives.text: It's fully comprehensive, with a £500 excess.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a bit steep. Do you know if I can reduce the excess?
dialogue.translation: 这有点贵。您知道能不能降低免赔额吗？
dialogue.tip: a bit steep 是英式委婉说「有点贵」；do you know if 后接完整句子提问。

alternatives.text: That's a little pricey. Can I lower the excess?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can, by paying a bit extra up front — it brings the excess right down.
dialogue.translation: 可以，只要预付一点额外费用——就能把免赔额降下来。
dialogue.tip: up front 指「提前／预付」；bring down 表示「降低」；right 在这里加强语气。

alternatives.text: Yes, pay a little more now and the excess drops.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Now, what do you need in terms of my driving licence?
dialogue.translation: 有道理。那关于驾照，你们需要什么？
dialogue.tip: fair enough 表示「行，可以接受」；in terms of 是「关于／就……而言」的地道表达。

alternatives.text: Okay. What do you need to see from my licence?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A full photocard licence, please. Is yours a UK one or an international licence?
dialogue.translation: 需要正式的卡片式驾照。您的是英国的还是国际驾照？
dialogue.tip: full licence 指「正式驾照」，相对 provisional 临时驾照；photocard 是带照片的卡式驾照。

alternatives.text: A full photocard licence. Is it UK or overseas?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's an international one, but I've got my UK provisional as well.
dialogue.translation: 是国际驾照，不过我也有英国的临时驾照。
dialogue.tip: as well 放句尾表示「也」；international licence 指「国际驾照」。

alternatives.text: It's international. I also have a UK provisional.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No worries, the international one's fine as long as it's in English.
dialogue.translation: 没问题，国际驾照可以，只要是英文的就行。
dialogue.tip: no worries 是英式「没关系／可以」；as long as 表示「只要」。

alternatives.text: That's fine, provided it's in English.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant. Could I ask about the fuel policy before I sign?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。签约前能问问燃油政策吗？
dialogue.tip: brilliant 是英式高频「太好了」；fuel policy 指租车「燃油政策」。

alternatives.text: Great. What's the fuel policy, before I sign?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's full to full — pick it up full, bring it back full. Simple.
dialogue.translation: 满油取满油还——取车时满油，还车时也加满。很简单。
dialogue.tip: full to full 是「满油取还」政策；pick up、bring back 是取车还车常用短语。

alternatives.text: Full to full. Collect it full and return it full.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll go for the compact then. Where do I pick it up tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: 那我就选小型车。明天去哪儿取车？
dialogue.tip: go for 表示「选择」；pick up 在这里指「取车」。

alternatives.text: I'll take the compact. Where's the collection point?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here, from eight tomorrow. Just bring your licence and the same card, please.
dialogue.translation: 就在这儿，明天八点开始。带上驾照和付款的那张卡就行。
dialogue.tip: just bring... 是提醒带东西的常用句；the same card 指付款用的那张卡。

alternatives.text: From eight here. Bring your licence and payment card.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheers. Actually, while I'm here, do you also handle flat rentals?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。对了，既然来了，你们也办理房屋租赁吗？
dialogue.tip: cheers 是英式「谢谢」；while I'm here 自然过渡话题；handle 表示「办理／负责」。

alternatives.text: Thanks. By the way, do you do flat lettings too?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We do, yes. Are you after a flat to rent in this area?
dialogue.translation: 是的，我们办理。您是在这一区想租公寓吗？
dialogue.tip: we do 是 we do handle 的省略；be after 再次表示「在找」。

alternatives.text: Yes, we do. Looking for a flat around here?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's right. A one-bed flat near the station, if there's anything going.
dialogue.translation: 没错。想找车站附近的一居室，如果有的话。
dialogue.tip: one-bed 是 one-bedroom 的口语缩写；if there's anything going 表示「如果有的话」。

alternatives.text: Yes, a one-bed near the station, if you have any.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There is one on Bridge Street — quite handy for the station, actually.
dialogue.translation: 桥街有一套——其实离车站挺方便的。
dialogue.tip: quite handy 是英式「挺方便」；actually 放句尾作补充说明。

alternatives.text: There's one on Bridge Street, very close to the station.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sounds good. How much is the rent, and what's included?
dialogue.translation: 听起来不错。租金多少，包含什么？
dialogue.tip: sounds good 表示「听起来不错」；what's included 问「包含哪些」。

alternatives.text: Nice. What's the rent and what does it cover?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's nine hundred a month, but that doesn't include bills or council tax.
dialogue.translation: 一个月九百镑，但不包含水电账单和市政税。
dialogue.tip: bills 指水电网等账单；council tax 是英国按房产征收的市政税。

alternatives.text: £900 a month, plus bills and council tax.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right. And the deposit — how much would that be?
dialogue.translation: 好的。那押金是多少？
dialogue.tip: deposit 指租房「押金」；how much would that be 是委婉问价。

alternatives.text: Okay, and what's the deposit?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Five weeks' rent, held in a government-protected scheme.
dialogue.translation: 五周租金，存放在政府监管的计划里。
dialogue.tip: five weeks' rent 是所有格「五周的租金」；protected scheme 指押金保护计划。

alternatives.text: It's five weeks' rent, in a protected deposit scheme.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. How long is the tenancy? I'm not after anything too long.
dialogue.translation: 好。租期多久？我不想租太久。
dialogue.tip: tenancy 指「租期／租赁」；not after anything too long 用 be after 的否定委婉表达。

alternatives.text: Fine. What's the length of the tenancy? Nothing too long.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Six months to start, with a break clause after three. Does that suit?
dialogue.translation: 先签六个月，三个月后有提前解约条款。这样合适吗？
dialogue.tip: break clause 是「提前解约条款」；does that suit 用来问「合适吗」。

alternatives.text: Six months, but you can leave after three. Okay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It does. Is it furnished? I've got hardly any furniture of my own.
dialogue.translation: 合适。房子带家具吗？我自己几乎没什么家具。
dialogue.tip: furnished 指「带家具的」；hardly any 表示「几乎没有」。

alternatives.text: Yes. Does it come furnished? I've got very little furniture.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is — bed, sofa, washing machine, the lot. There's broadband too.
dialogue.translation: 带的——床、沙发、洗衣机，一应俱全。还有宽带。
dialogue.tip: the lot 是英式口语「全部／一应俱全」；broadband 指「宽带」。

alternatives.text: Yes, it's fully furnished, with broadband included.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lovely. Do you mind if I pop in and have a look this week?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。我这两天顺路过来看看，介意吗？
dialogue.tip: do you mind if 是礼貌请求；pop in 指「顺路来访」；have a look 是「看一看」。

alternatives.text: Great. Could I come and see it sometime this week?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not at all. Shall we say Thursday? I'll get the paperwork ready.
dialogue.translation: 完全不介意。定周四怎么样？我把文件准备好。
dialogue.tip: not at all 回应 do you mind 表示「不介意」；shall we 用于提议；paperwork 指签约文件。

alternatives.text: Of course. How about Thursday? I'll prepare the documents.

exercises.question: 对话里 I'm after a small car 中 be after 的意思是？
exercises.explanation: be after 在英式口语中表示「想找某物／想要」，比 I want 委婉地道。

exercises.question: 租车时对方说 there's a £500 excess，excess 指的是什么？
exercises.explanation: excess 是保险里的「免赔额」，出险时需要自己承担的那部分金额。

exercises.question: Does it come with broadband? 中 come with 的意思是？
exercises.explanation: come with 表示「附带／包含某配置」，问保险、设施、家电都很好用。

exercises.question: 想委婉地说租金「有点贵」，最地道的说法是？
exercises.explanation: a bit steep 是英式含蓄说「有点贵」的地道表达，加 a bit 语气更得体。

scenes.title: 餐馆
scenes.description: 在英国餐馆从订位、看菜单、点餐、忌口过敏到加水催菜、打包付账（含服务费）的真实交流

patterns.sentence: I'd like to book a table for ___.
patterns.note: book a table 是订位最地道的固定搭配，后面接人数或时间都很自然。
一个句型搞定索要菜单、加水、结账和餐具，比 Give me 礼貌百倍。
问有没有某类菜品或设施，万能又简单，说明忌口时尤其好用。
go for 表示「选择」，点餐时比 I want 更自然得体。
英式用 I'm afraid 缓和坏消息或抱怨，礼貌又有分寸。
结账时问支付方式的万能句，把支付方式填进去即可。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I'd like to book a table for two for tonight, if possible.
dialogue.translation: 您好，我想订一张今晚两人用餐的桌子，可以吗？
dialogue.tip: I'd like to 是礼貌表达意愿的固定说法；book a table 是订位的地道搭配。

alternatives.text: Hi, could I book a table for two tonight?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Certainly. What time were you thinking?
dialogue.translation: 当然可以。您大概想几点？
dialogue.tip: were you thinking 是英式委婉询问对方想法的说法，语气比 What time? 柔和。

alternatives.text: Of course. What time suits you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Around seven thirty, please. Somewhere a bit quieter, if that's alright.
dialogue.translation: 大概七点半吧。如果可以的话，想要安静一点的位置。
dialogue.tip: Around 表示「大约」；if that's alright 是英式礼貌附加语，让请求更委婉。

alternatives.text: Seven thirty, please. Somewhere quiet if possible.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me see... I can do seven thirty by the window. Would that suit?
dialogue.translation: 我看看……七点半靠窗的位子可以。您觉得行吗？
dialogue.tip: I can do 表示「我能安排」；Would that suit? 是英式礼貌询问「这样合适吗」。

alternatives.text: Seven thirty by the window is free. Is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Yes, please — it's just the two of us.
dialogue.translation: 听起来很好。就要这个——就我们两位。
dialogue.tip: That sounds lovely 是英式常见回应，表示「听起来不错」；just the two of us 说明人数。

alternatives.text: Great, we'll take it. There are only two of us.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Brilliant. Could I take a name for the booking?
dialogue.translation: 好的。能留下预订的姓名吗？
dialogue.tip: Brilliant 是英式高频的「好极了」；take a name 指「记下名字」。

alternatives.text: Lovely. What name should I put down?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good evening. We've got a booking for seven thirty, a table for two.
dialogue.translation: 晚上好。我们订了七点半两位用餐的位子。
dialogue.tip: We've got a booking 是到店的口头语；good evening 是晚间到店的礼貌问候。

alternatives.text: Evening. We have a reservation for two at seven thirty.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Follow me this way — is the window table alright for you?
dialogue.translation: 当然。请跟我这边走——靠窗那桌可以吗？
dialogue.tip: Follow me this way 是带位常用语；is ... alright for you 礼貌地请对方确认。

alternatives.text: Right this way. Would you like the window table?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you. Could we have the menu, please?
dialogue.translation: 很好，谢谢。能把菜单给我们吗？
dialogue.tip: Could we have...? 是索要物品的万能句型，比 Give me 礼貌得多。

alternatives.text: Thanks. May we see the menu, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here you go. Can I get you anything to drink while you have a look?
dialogue.translation: 给您。您先看菜单，要不要先来点喝的？
dialogue.tip: Here you go 是递东西时的地道用语；while you have a look 表示「您看菜单时」。

alternatives.text: Here you are. Would you like a drink while you decide?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, could I have a glass of the house red, and some still water for the table?
dialogue.translation: 好的，能给我一杯本店红酒，再给桌上加点无气泡水吗？
dialogue.tip: a glass of 是点饮品的量词；house red 指餐厅自荐的红葡萄酒。

alternatives.text: A glass of house red, please, and some still water.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Certainly. The house red's a Merlot. Would you like to see the wine list as well?
dialogue.translation: 当然。本店红酒是梅洛。您也要看看酒单吗？
dialogue.tip: Merlot 是常见葡萄品种；as well 放句尾表示「也」，很口语。

alternatives.text: Of course. It's a Merlot. Would you like the wine list too?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No, we're fine, thanks. Actually, do you have any vegan options? My partner doesn't eat dairy.
dialogue.translation: 不用了，谢谢。对了，你们有纯素菜品吗？我同伴不吃乳制品。
dialogue.tip: Do you have any...? 是询问是否有某类菜品的万能句；vegan 指纯素（不含任何动物成分）。

alternatives.text: Actually, is there anything vegan? My partner avoids dairy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We do. The mushroom risotto is vegan, and the tomato soup's made without cream.
dialogue.translation: 有的。蘑菇烩饭是纯素的，番茄汤也不含奶油。
dialogue.tip: We do 是 We do have vegan options 的省略；be made without 表示「制作时不加……」。

alternatives.text: Yes, the risotto's vegan and the soup has no cream.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. I'm also allergic to nuts — is anything cooked with them?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。我还对坚果过敏——有菜是用坚果做的吗？
dialogue.tip: be allergic to 是「对……过敏」的固定说法；cooked with 表示「用……烹制」。

alternatives.text: I've got a nut allergy — do any dishes contain nuts?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'll check with the kitchen. Most mains are nut-free, but the puddings often contain them.
dialogue.translation: 我去后厨确认一下。大多数主菜不含坚果，但甜点常含有。
dialogue.tip: check with the kitchen 是餐厅常用语；nut-free 是「不含坚果」的复合形容词。

alternatives.text: Let me ask the kitchen. Mains are fine, but desserts may have nuts.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Much appreciated. In that case, I'll go for the steak, and she'll have the risotto.
dialogue.translation: 非常感谢。那样的话，我要牛排，她要烩饭。
dialogue.tip: Much appreciated 是礼貌的「非常感谢」；go for 表示「选择」。

alternatives.text: Thanks. I'll have the steak and she'll take the risotto.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. How would you like your steak cooked?
dialogue.translation: 好的。您的牛排想要几分熟？
dialogue.tip: How would you like...cooked? 是问牛排熟度的标准句。

alternatives.text: Great choice. How do you like your steak done?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Medium rare, please. And could we get some more water when you get a chance?
dialogue.translation: 三分熟，谢谢。另外您方便的时候能再给我们加点水吗？
dialogue.tip: medium rare 指「三分熟」；when you get a chance 是委婉催请的地道说法。

alternatives.text: Medium rare, please. Could we have some more water too?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll bring a jug over straight away.
dialogue.translation: 当然。我马上拿壶水过来。
dialogue.tip: a jug 指带柄的水壶；straight away 是英式「立刻、马上」。

alternatives.text: Sure, I'll bring some over right now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, this steak's a bit cold — could you take it back and warm it up?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，这牛排有点凉——能拿回去热一下吗？
dialogue.tip: a bit cold 是英式含蓄抱怨；take it back 指「拿回去（厨房）」。

alternatives.text: Sorry, the steak's cold. Could you warm it up?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm ever so sorry. Let me get you a fresh one straight away.
dialogue.translation: 非常抱歉。我马上给您换一份新的。
dialogue.tip: ever so sorry 是英式加强道歉的说法；fresh 指「新做的一份」。

alternatives.text: I'm really sorry. I'll bring you another one right away.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. And we're still waiting on the risotto — has it gone to the wrong table?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。还有我们的烩饭还没上——是不是送错桌了？
dialogue.tip: still waiting on 表示「还在等」；gone to the wrong table 是「送错桌」的地道说法。

alternatives.text: And the risotto hasn't arrived — has it gone to someone else?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm really sorry about that, it's just coming out now. Can I get you anything else while you wait?
dialogue.translation: 非常抱歉，马上就上桌了。等待期间还需要别的吗？
dialogue.tip: coming out 指菜「出锅上桌」；while you wait 是等待时的礼貌补充。

alternatives.text: Sorry, it's on its way. Anything else in the meantime?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No, we're alright. Could we order dessert now — the crème brûlée and a coffee, please?
dialogue.translation: 不用了，我们还好。现在能点甜点吗——一份焦糖布丁和一杯咖啡？
dialogue.tip: We're alright 是英式「我们不用了」；order dessert 是「点甜点」。

alternatives.text: We're fine, thanks. We'd like the crème brûlée and a coffee.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Certainly. I'll bring those over in a moment.
dialogue.translation: 好的。我稍后给您端过来。
dialogue.tip: in a moment 是「稍等片刻」的地道说法，比 wait 更自然。

alternatives.text: Of course, coming right up.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That was delicious, thanks. Could we have the bill, please?
dialogue.translation: 味道真好，谢谢。能给我们账单吗？
dialogue.tip: Could we have the bill? 是英国餐厅结账的固定说法（美式常用 check）。

alternatives.text: Lovely, thank you. Could we get the bill, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here you are. The service charge is included, so there's nothing extra to add.
dialogue.translation: 给您。服务费已包含在内，所以不用额外加钱。
dialogue.tip: service charge 是英国餐厅常见的服务费（常为 10-12.5%）；included 表示「已含」。

alternatives.text: Here you go. Service is already included, so nothing to add.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ah, right. Do you take contactless? And could we have a box for the leftover cake, please?
dialogue.translation: 啊，好的。支持非接触支付吗？另外能给我们个盒子装剩下的蛋糕吗？
dialogue.tip: Do you take contactless? 问是否支持挥卡；a box for the leftovers 是英国「打包」的说法。

alternatives.text: Can I tap my card? And could we take the rest away in a box?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We do — just tap here. Here's your box. Hope you enjoyed it, cheers!
dialogue.translation: 支持的——在这里刷一下就行。给您盒子。希望您吃得开心，谢谢！
dialogue.tip: cheers 在这里既是「谢谢」也是友好道别；tap here 指在这个位置挥卡。

alternatives.text: Yes, tap here please. There's your box — have a lovely evening!

exercises.question: 你想礼貌地订一张今晚两人的桌子，最合适的说法是？
options: Give me a table for two.
I'd like to book a table for two for tonight.
exercises.explanation: I'd like to book a table for... 是订位最地道、最礼貌的说法。

exercises.question: 你对坚果过敏，最地道的表达是？
exercises.explanation: be allergic to 表示「对……过敏」，是说明忌口的标准说法。

exercises.question: 服务员说 The service charge is included，意思是？
options: 服务费已包含，无需另付
exercises.explanation: service charge 是服务费，included 表示已包含在账单里，不用额外付。

exercises.question: 结账时你想问能否挥卡支付，应说？
exercises.explanation: contactless 指非接触支付，Do you take...? 用来询问餐厅接受的付款方式。

scenes.title: 购买机票或门票
scenes.description: 在英国旅行社从查航班、订机票、选座、问行李额度、改签退票到买景点门票的真实交流

patterns.note: be after 是英式口语里「想找某物」的地道说法，比 I want 自然得多。
一个句型问遍各种信息，后面直接接完整句子即可，礼貌又万能。
礼貌索要任何东西都适用，比 Can I have 更客气地道。
做决定时比 I want 更自然，表示「我选这个」。
英式含蓄表达不满，加 a bit 语气更委婉得体，不显粗鲁。
问假设和后果的万能句，订票时问改签退票政策特别好用。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm after a return flight to Edinburgh for a long weekend. What have you got?
dialogue.translation: 你好，我想找一张去爱丁堡的往返机票，过一个长周末。有什么航班吗？
dialogue.tip: be after 是英式口语「想找某物」的地道说法；What have you got 是问「有什么可选」。

alternatives.text: I'm looking for a return to Edinburgh for a long weekend.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right, and when were you thinking of going?
dialogue.translation: 好的，您打算什么时候出发？
dialogue.tip: be thinking of doing 是委婉询问「打算何时做某事」的常用句型。

alternatives.text: And what dates did you have in mind?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: From the twelfth — a Friday — back on the Sunday. Nothing too early, though.
dialogue.translation: 十二号出发——周五——周日回来。不过别太早。
dialogue.tip: 句末的 though 是英式口语常见的委婉补充，相当于「不过」。

words.meaning: 不过，但是（句末委婉语气）

alternatives.text: Twelfth to the Sunday. I'd rather not fly too early.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me have a look... there's a decent one at half past nine on the Friday.
dialogue.translation: 我看看……周五有一班九点半的，还不错。
dialogue.tip: have a look 是「看一下」的地道说法；decent 在英式口语里常表示「还不错」。

alternatives.text: Let me check — there's a good one at nine thirty.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is that direct? And what kind of price are we talking?
dialogue.translation: 是直飞吗？大概什么价位？
dialogue.tip: what kind of price are we talking 是询问价位的地道口语，比 How much 更自然。

alternatives.text: Is it a direct flight, and roughly how much?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's direct, and it comes to a hundred and eighty pounds return.
dialogue.translation: 直飞，往返一共一百八十英镑。
dialogue.tip: comes to 表示「总计为」；英国票价用 pound（英镑）。

alternatives.text: Direct, and it's £180 return.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a bit steep. Is there anything a bit cheaper?
dialogue.translation: 有点贵。有没有便宜点的？
dialogue.tip: a bit steep 是英式含蓄说「太贵」的说法，a bit 让语气更委婉。

alternatives.text: That's rather pricey. Anything cheaper?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There's a seven o'clock one that's a tenner less, but it's an early start.
dialogue.translation: 有班七点的，便宜十英镑，不过得起个大早。
dialogue.tip: tenner 是英式口语「十英镑」；quid 也是常用的「英镑」（复数不变）。

alternatives.text: There's one at seven that's ten quid cheaper, but it's early.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll go for the nine thirty, I think. That's more civilised.
dialogue.translation: 我想还是选九点半那班吧，那个时间更体面。
dialogue.tip: go for 表示「选择」；civilised 此处幽默地指「体面、不用太遭罪」。

alternatives.text: I'll take the nine thirty — that's a better time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good choice. Now, would you like a window or an aisle seat?
dialogue.translation: 好选择。您想要靠窗还是靠过道的座位？
dialogue.tip: aisle 里的 s 不发音，读作 /aɪl/；英式常直接说 window or aisle。

alternatives.text: Lovely. Window or aisle?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: An aisle seat, please. Is there any extra legroom going?
dialogue.translation: 请给我靠过道的。还有腿部空间大一点的座位吗？
dialogue.tip: going 在此表示「可提供的」，Is there any... going? 是英式口语问「有没有……」。

alternatives.text: Aisle, please. Do you have seats with more legroom?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There is, but that's an extra fifteen quid in the exit row.
dialogue.translation: 有，不过在紧急出口那排，要多加十五英镑。
dialogue.tip: quid 是英式「英镑」，单复数同形，如 fifteen quid；exit row 通常腿部空间更大。

alternatives.text: Yes, in the exit row, but it's fifteen pounds extra.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll stick with the standard seat. Does the fare include a hold bag?
dialogue.translation: 我还是选普通座位吧。票价包含托运行李吗？
dialogue.tip: stick with 表示「坚持原来的选择」；hold bag 指需要托运的行李。

alternatives.text: I'll keep the standard seat. Is a checked bag included?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just a cabin bag, I'm afraid. Hold bags are thirty pounds each way.
dialogue.translation: 恐怕只含一个随身包。托运行李单程三十英镑。
dialogue.tip: I'm afraid 是英式委婉坏消息的开场；each way 指「单程」。

alternatives.text: Only a small cabin bag. It's £30 each way for a hold bag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll add one bag, then. Could you pop that on the booking?
dialogue.translation: 那我加一件行李吧。能帮我加到订单里吗？
dialogue.tip: pop something on 是「随手加上」的地道说法，非常英式口语。

alternatives.text: I'll add one bag, then. Could you put that on the booking?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Can I take your name, please?
dialogue.translation: 当然。请问您叫什么名字？
dialogue.tip: Can I take your name 是服务行业记录姓名的固定礼貌用语。

alternatives.text: Sure. Could I have your name?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's Sarah Davies — that's D-A-V-I-E-S, if that helps.
dialogue.translation: 我叫 Sarah Davies——拼写是 D-A-V-I-E-S，如果需要的话。
dialogue.tip: 报姓名时主动拼读并加 if that helps，是英式服务场景里贴心的常见做法。

alternatives.text: Sarah Davies. Let me spell it — D-A-V-I-E-S.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lovely. And how would you like to pay for the ticket and the bag?
dialogue.translation: 好的。机票和行李您想怎么支付？
dialogue.tip: Lovely 是英式高频词，表示「好的/太好了」，语气亲切。

alternatives.text: Great. How would you like to pay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: By card, please. Here you go.
dialogue.translation: 刷卡吧，给你。
dialogue.tip: Here you go 是递东西时的地道说法，相当于「给你」。

alternatives.text: Card, please. Here's my card.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're all set — your booking reference is K7X2QP.
dialogue.translation: 都办好了——您的预订编号是 K7X2QP。
dialogue.tip: You're all set 表示「都办妥了」；booking reference 是订单/预订编号。

alternatives.text: All done — that's your reference: K7X2QP.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheers. Now, what if I need to change the date later?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。那如果我之后要改日期怎么办？
dialogue.tip: Cheers 是英式最常用的「谢谢」；what if 用来问「万一……怎么办」。

alternatives.text: Thanks. And what happens if I need to change the date?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Changes are fifty quid, unless you go for the flexible fare.
dialogue.translation: 改签要五十英镑，除非您选的是灵活票价。
dialogue.tip: flexible fare 指可低成本改签的票价；unless 引出例外条件。

alternatives.text: It's £50 to change, unless it's a flexible ticket.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right. And if I cancelled altogether, would I get a refund?
dialogue.translation: 好的。那如果我整个取消，能退款吗？
dialogue.tip: altogether 在此表示「彻底、完全」；refund 是「退款」。

alternatives.text: And what if I cancelled — could I get my money back?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm afraid it's non-refundable, but you could change the name.
dialogue.translation: 恐怕不能退款，不过您可以改名字。
dialogue.tip: non-refundable 是「不可退票」；英式常用 I'm afraid 缓和坏消息。

alternatives.text: Sorry, no refunds, but you can change the name.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Oh, one more thing — could you sort out some tickets for Edinburgh Castle?
dialogue.translation: 行吧。哦，还有件事——能帮我弄几张爱丁堡城堡的门票吗？
dialogue.tip: Fair enough 表示「可以理解/行吧」；sort out 是「安排、搞定」的地道短语。

alternatives.text: Okay. Could you also book some tickets for Edinburgh Castle?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Certainly. They use timed entry — which session were you after?
dialogue.translation: 当然。他们分时段入场——您想订哪个时段？
dialogue.tip: timed entry 指「按时段入场」；session 在此指参观的「场次/时段」。

alternatives.text: Sure. They've got timed slots — which time suits?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sunday morning, if possible. Do they do a family ticket or any concession?
dialogue.translation: 如果可以的话，周日上午。他们有家庭票或者优惠票吗？
dialogue.tip: concession 指学生/老人等的「优惠票」；if possible 让请求更委婉。

alternatives.text: Sunday morning, please. Any family or concession rates?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: An adult's eighteen pounds, and under-fives go free.
dialogue.translation: 成人票十八英镑，五岁以下儿童免费。
dialogue.tip: go free 表示「免费入场」；under-fives 指「五岁以下儿童」。

alternatives.text: It's £18 for an adult, and under-fives are free.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant, I'll take two adults. Could you email the tickets over?
dialogue.translation: 太好了，我要两张成人票。能把票发到我邮箱吗？
dialogue.tip: Brilliant 是英式高频赞美词；email something over 指「把……发到邮箱」。

alternatives.text: Great, two adults please. Could you send them by email?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: All done — they'll be with you shortly. Have a brilliant trip!
dialogue.translation: 都办好了——票很快就到您邮箱。祝您旅途愉快！
dialogue.tip: shortly 表示「不久之后」；Have a brilliant trip 是热情的旅行道别祝福。

alternatives.text: Sorted — you'll get them soon. Enjoy your trip!

exercises.question: 想说「我想找一张去爱丁堡的往返机票」，最地道的说法是？
options: I want a flight to Edinburgh.
I'm after a return flight to Edinburgh.
I have a flight to Edinburgh.
exercises.explanation: be after 在英式口语里表示「想找某物」，比 I want 自然地道得多。

exercises.question: 店员说 「That's a bit steep」，意思是？
exercises.explanation: a bit steep 是英式含蓄说价格「有点贵」，加 a bit 让语气更委婉。

exercises.question: 「It's non-refundable」的意思是？
exercises.explanation: non-refundable 指「不可退款」，是机票条款的常见词。

exercises.question: 询问是否有学生或老人优惠票，应该用哪个词？
exercises.explanation: concession 在英式英语里指学生、老人等享受的「优惠票」。

scenes.title: 打车和问路
scenes.description: 在英国从街头打车、报目的地、沟通路况与车费，到问路指路、买票乘地铁公交换乘、问距离与路程时间的真实交流

patterns.sentence: Could you take me to ___, please?
patterns.note: 打车报目的地的核心句，把地点填进去即可，比 Tell the driver 礼貌自然得多。

patterns.sentence: How long will it take to ___?
patterns.note: 问路程时间的万能句，打车、步行、坐地铁都能用，把动作填进去就行。
委婉提出请求的英式句型，比直接下命令礼貌得多，司机路人都能用。
问路时最地道的指路请求，point somebody towards 是固定搭配。

patterns.sentence: Which line should I take to ___?
patterns.note: 坐地铁问线路的万能句，只需替换目的地，站务员一听就懂。
确认流程的句型，办交通卡、换乘、买票时都很实用，避免手忙脚乱。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Morning. Are you free? Could you take me to Canary Wharf, please?
dialogue.translation: 早上好。您空车吗？能送我去金丝雀码头吗？
dialogue.tip: 「Are you free?」是英国街头叫出租车的常用问法，相当于问「空车吗」。

alternatives.text: Hi, is this taxi available? Canary Wharf, please.
alternatives.meaning: 更正式一点的叫车问法

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I am, mate. Hop in. Whereabouts in Canary Wharf are you after?
dialogue.translation: 空的，朋友。上车吧。您要去金丝雀码头的哪儿？
dialogue.tip: 「hop in」是英式「上车」；「be after」在这里表示「要去／在找」，非常地道。

alternatives.text: Sure thing. Get in. Which part of Canary Wharf?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The Jacobs Building, on Westferry Road. How long will it take roughly?
dialogue.translation: 雅各布大楼，在西渡路。大概要多久？
dialogue.tip: 「roughly」放句尾表示「大约」，是英式口语常见的模糊表达。

alternatives.text: The Jacobs Building, Westferry Road. About how long d'you reckon?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Depends on the traffic, to be honest. Half an hour, give or take.
dialogue.translation: 说实话得看路况。半小时左右吧。
dialogue.tip: 「give or take」是地道的「大约、上下浮动」；「to be honest」是英式高频口头语。

alternatives.text: Hard to say with the traffic. About thirty minutes or so.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it backed up anywhere? I've got an interview at ten.
dialogue.translation: 哪儿堵车吗？我十点有个面试。
dialogue.tip: 「backed up」形容交通「堵住了」；「I've got」在英式英语里常表示「有（安排）」。

alternatives.text: Is there much traffic? I need to be there by ten.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There's a bit of a jam by the tunnel, but I know a shortcut through the side streets.
dialogue.translation: 隧道那边有点堵，不过我知道穿小巷的近路。
dialogue.tip: 「a bit of a jam」用「a bit of」淡化，是英式含蓄表达；「shortcut」指近路。

alternatives.text: It's congested near the tunnel, but I can take a quicker route.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's brilliant. Do you mind going that way? I don't know the area at all.
dialogue.translation: 太好了。您介意走那条路吗？我对这片区一点都不熟。
dialogue.tip: 「That's brilliant」是英式高频称赞；「Do you mind...?」用来礼貌地提出请求。

alternatives.text: Lovely, thanks. Would you mind taking that route? I'm not local.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not at all. I'll put the meter on — it's slightly longer, but we'll dodge the jam.
dialogue.translation: 完全不介意。我打表——路程稍长点，但能避开拥堵。
dialogue.tip: 「put the meter on」是出租车「打表」的地道说法；「dodge」表示灵活避开。

alternatives.text: No problem. Meter's on — a bit further, but we'll miss the traffic.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fine by me. And roughly what's the fare? I'd rather pay by card.
dialogue.translation: 我没问题。车费大概多少？我更想刷卡。
dialogue.tip: 「Fine by me」是英式「我没意见」；「fare」专指车费；「I'd rather」表示偏好。

alternatives.text: That's fine. About how much will it be? Can I pay by card?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Around twenty quid. Just tap here when we get there. Right, this is you.
dialogue.translation: 大概二十镑。到了在这儿刷一下卡就行。好了，您到了。
dialogue.tip: 「quid」是英式「英镑」，单复数同形；「this is you」是司机说「到了」的常用语。

alternatives.text: About twenty pounds. Tap your card here. Here we are.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot. Right, where's the nearest tube station from here?
dialogue.translation: 非常感谢。对了，这附近最近的地铁站在哪儿？
dialogue.tip: 「tube」是伦敦地铁的口语叫法（正式叫 Underground）；「right」用于转换话题。

alternatives.text: Cheers. Where's the closest Underground station, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Canary Wharf station's just over the road. You can't miss it.
dialogue.translation: 金丝雀码头站就在马路对面。你肯定能找到。
dialogue.tip: 「just over the road」表示「就在对面」；「You can't miss it」是指路时安慰对方的地道说法。

alternatives.text: It's right across the street. Impossible to miss.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sorry, could you point me towards the entrance? I'm hopeless with directions.
dialogue.translation: 不好意思，您能给我指一下入口在哪边吗？我方向感特别差。
dialogue.tip: 「point me towards」是请人指路的地道表达；「hopeless with directions」是英式自嘲「方向感差」。

alternatives.text: Could you show me where the entrance is? I always get lost.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Go straight on, then take the first right past the pub.
dialogue.translation: 当然。一直往前走，过了酒吧第一个路口右转。
dialogue.tip: 「Go straight on」和「take the first right」是英式指路的核心句型。

alternatives.text: Straight ahead, then first right after the pub.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Straight on, first right past the pub. Is it far from here?
dialogue.translation: 直走，过酒吧右转。离这儿远吗？
dialogue.tip: 重复对方的话确认，是真实交流中避免走错的好习惯；「far from here」问距离。

alternatives.text: So, straight on and first right. How far is it, roughly?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not far at all — about a two-minute walk. Follow the signs for the Underground.
dialogue.translation: 一点都不远——走路大概两分钟。跟着地铁的指示牌走就行。
dialogue.tip: 「Not far at all」完全否定，语气强；「follow the signs」是「跟着标识走」的地道说法。

alternatives.text: It's only a couple of minutes on foot. Just follow the signs.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant, cheers. That's really helpful.
dialogue.translation: 太好了，谢谢。真是帮了大忙。
dialogue.tip: 「cheers」在英式英语里是随和的「谢谢」；「That's really helpful」是真诚的感谢。

alternatives.text: Great, thanks a million. Much appreciated.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I need to get to the British Museum. Which line should I take?
dialogue.translation: 打扰一下，我要去大英博物馆。该坐哪条线？
dialogue.tip: 「Which line should I take?」是问地铁线路的万能句；「get to」表示「到达」。

alternatives.text: Sorry, how do I get to the British Museum from here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take the Elizabeth line to Tottenham Court Road, then change to the Northern line.
dialogue.translation: 坐伊丽莎白线到托特纳姆法院路，然后换北线。
dialogue.tip: 「change (trains)」是英式「换乘」的标准说法，美式常用 transfer。

alternatives.text: Get the Elizabeth line to Tottenham Court Road and switch to the Northern line.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sorry, change at Tottenham Court Road onto the Northern line? Could you repeat that?
dialogue.translation: 不好意思，在托特纳姆法院路换北线？您能再说一遍吗？
dialogue.tip: 「Could you repeat that?」是请求重复的礼貌说法；听不清时别怕追问。

alternatives.text: Sorry, was that Tottenham Court Road? Could you say it again, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's right. The Northern line, southbound. It's only two stops to the museum.
dialogue.translation: 没错。北线，往南方向。到博物馆只有两站。
dialogue.tip: 「southbound / northbound」是地铁报方向的常用词；「stop」指「一站」。

alternatives.text: Yes, the southbound Northern line. Two stops and you're there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Two stops. And where do I buy a ticket? I haven't got an Oyster card.
dialogue.translation: 两站。我在哪儿买票？我没有牡蛎卡。
dialogue.tip: 「Oyster card」是伦敦公交地铁通用的充值卡；「haven't got」是英式「没有」。

alternatives.text: Two stops, great. Where can I buy a ticket? I don't have an Oyster card.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can just tap your contactless card at the gate, or use the machine over there.
dialogue.translation: 你可以直接在闸机上刷非接触卡，或者用那边的机器买票。
dialogue.tip: 「tap ... at the gate」是刷卡进站的地道说法；伦敦地铁广泛支持 contactless。

alternatives.text: Just tap your card at the barrier, or grab a ticket from the machine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll get an Oyster card, I think. Do I need to top it up first?
dialogue.translation: 我想我还是办张牡蛎卡吧。我需要先充值吗？
dialogue.tip: 「top up」是英式「充值、加值」的固定说法，手机话费、交通卡都用它。

alternatives.text: I'll go for an Oyster card. Do I have to put credit on it first?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It comes with a bit of credit already. You can top up at any station later.
dialogue.translation: 卡里已经有一点余额了。之后在任意车站都能充值。
dialogue.tip: 「come with」表示「附带」；「credit」这里指卡内「余额／额度」。

alternatives.text: There's already some credit on it. You can add more at any station.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lovely. And roughly how long will the whole journey take?
dialogue.translation: 好的。整个行程大概要多久？
dialogue.tip: 「journey」是英式「行程」（美式常用 trip）；「roughly how long」问大概时长。

alternatives.text: Great. About how long will it take in total?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ten minutes or so, including the change. You've got plenty of time.
dialogue.translation: 十分钟上下，包括换乘。时间很充裕。
dialogue.tip: 「or so」放数量词后表「大约」；「plenty of time」是「时间充裕」的地道说法。

alternatives.text: Around ten minutes with the change. You're fine for time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Is the platform downstairs? I keep hearing that announcement about delays.
dialogue.translation: 好的。站台在楼下吗？我总听到延误的广播。
dialogue.tip: 「platform」是英式「站台」；「keep hearing」用进行时态表示「老是听到」。

alternatives.text: Good. Is the platform downstairs? There's a lot of delay announcements.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, down the escalator. Don't worry — that's just the usual weekend engineering work.
dialogue.translation: 是的，下扶梯就到。别担心——那只是周末常规的维修施工。
dialogue.tip: 「escalator」指自动扶梯；英国周末常因 engineering work 调整列车，是当地常识。

alternatives.text: Down the escalator, yes. It's just routine weekend engineering works.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, I've got my card. Off I go — thanks ever so much for your help, cheers!
dialogue.translation: 好了，卡办好了。我出发啦——非常感谢你的帮助，谢谢！
dialogue.tip: 「ever so」是英式加强语气的「非常」；「off I go」是出发时的轻松道别。

alternatives.text: Right, card's sorted. Better be off — thanks a million, cheers!

exercises.question: 在伦敦街头想叫一辆出租车，最地道的问法是？
exercises.explanation: 「Are you free?」是英式叫车的礼貌常用语，相当于问「空车吗」。

exercises.question: 出租车司机说 I'll put the meter on，意思是？
exercises.explanation: 「put the meter on」指启动计价器打表，meter 就是出租车的计价器。

exercises.question: 想礼貌地请司机走某条路，最合适的说法是？
options: Do you mind going this way?
exercises.explanation: 「Do you mind...?」是委婉提出请求的英式句型，语气比直接命令礼貌得多。

exercises.question: 交通卡语境下 top up 是什么意思？
exercises.explanation: 「top up」意为「充值、加值」，如 top up an Oyster card（给牡蛎卡充值）。

scenes.title: 询价和砍价
scenes.description: 在英国旧货市场从看货问价、含蓄讲价、批量购买谈折扣到二手物品验货、付款收尾的真实交流（含英式含蓄砍价文化）

patterns.note: 最直接也最常用的问价句，把名词换掉就能问任何东西的价格，简洁又地道。
英式讲价讲含蓄，用「有没有余地」代替直接喊便宜点，礼貌又不伤和气。
万能还价句型，把你想要的金额或条件填进去即可，比 Give me 委婉得多。
a bit 是英式含蓄表达，用「有点贵」代替「太贵」，既传达到意思又保持礼貌。

slots: only if you throw in the strap
patterns.note: 提出还价并附带条件的实用句型，让步与要求兼顾，谈判时非常顺手。
批量购买谈价的地道句型，用「多买换折扣」的思路，比硬砍价自然得多。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Morning! Mind if I have a little look around?
dialogue.translation: 早上好！介意我随便看看吗？
dialogue.tip: Mind if I...? 是英式礼貌征询说法；have a little look 是「看一看」的地道搭配。

alternatives.text: Hello. Do you mind if I have a browse?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not at all, help yourself. It's all second-hand, so do have a good browse.
dialogue.translation: 完全不介意，请随意。这些都是二手的，您尽管好好逛逛。
dialogue.tip: help yourself 表示「请自便」；browse 指随意浏览货品，是逛集市的高频词。

alternatives.text: Of course, go ahead. Have a proper look around.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheers. I'm actually after an old film camera — have you got anything like that?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。我其实想找一台老式胶片相机——你这儿有类似的吗？
dialogue.tip: be after 是英式口语「想要、在找」；anything like that 表示「类似的东西」。

alternatives.text: Thanks. I'm looking for an old film camera — got anything like that?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I might have, yeah. There's a couple over on that table. Take your time.
dialogue.translation: 可能有哦。那边桌子上有一两台。您慢慢看。
dialogue.tip: a couple 指「两三个」；take your time 是「慢慢来、不着急」的常用语。

alternatives.text: Maybe, yeah. There's one or two on that table. No rush.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ooh, this one's lovely. How much is it?
dialogue.translation: 哦，这台真好看。多少钱？
dialogue.tip: How much is it? 是最直接的问价句；lovely 是英式高频赞美词，ooh 带惊喜语气。

alternatives.text: This one's nice. What's the price?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a Canon, that is. I'd say forty quid, but it's a good camera.
dialogue.translation: 那可是台佳能。我要价四十镑，不过这是台好相机。
dialogue.tip: quid 是英式「英镑」的口语说法，不加复数；That's a..., that is 是英式强调句式。

alternatives.text: It's a Canon. Forty pounds, and it's a goodun.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Forty quid? Blimey, that's a bit more than I had in mind.
dialogue.translation: 四十镑？天哪，比我想的要贵一点。
dialogue.tip: Blimey 是英式惊叹词「天哪」；a bit more than I had in mind 是含蓄嫌贵的礼貌说法。

words.word: a bit more than I had in mind
words.ipa: /ə bɪt mɔː ðæn aɪ hæd ɪn maɪnd/

alternatives.text: Forty? That's a bit steep for me, to be honest.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I hear you. It's in lovely condition though — fully working, original lens.
dialogue.translation: 我明白你的意思。不过它成色很好——功能完好，原装镜头。
dialogue.tip: I hear you 是英式「我理解你说的」；in ... condition 表示「……的成色/状态」。

alternatives.text: I know what you mean, but it's spotless — works perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It is nice, I'll give you that. But I've seen similar ones cheaper online.
dialogue.translation: 确实不错，这点我承认。但我在网上见过类似的更便宜。
dialogue.tip: I'll give you that 是英式「这点我承认」；比价时说 seen ... cheaper 很地道。

alternatives.text: It's nice, fair enough. But you can get them cheaper online.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Online's online, isn't it? You can't hold it or try it. This one's been looked after.
dialogue.translation: 网上归网上，对吧？你摸不到也试不了。这台一直保养得很好。
dialogue.tip: You can't hold it or try it 点出二手实物的优势；be looked after 表示「被保养、被照料」。

alternatives.text: That's the internet for you. Here you can see it — and it's been well kept.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（well kept 指保养得好）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fair point. Is there any room for negotiation, then?
dialogue.translation: 有道理。那还有讲价的余地吗？
dialogue.tip: Fair point 表示「说得有理」；room for negotiation 是「议价空间」的地道说法。

alternatives.text: Good point. Would you take less, then?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I could maybe do thirty-five for you, seeing as you're a nice chap.
dialogue.translation: 看在你人不错的份上，我可以给你算三十五。
dialogue.tip: seeing as 是英式「既然、鉴于」；chap 是英式口语「小伙子、家伙」，带亲切感。

alternatives.text: I might do thirty-five, since you seem alright.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thirty-five... Could you do thirty? That's my absolute top price.
dialogue.translation: 三十五……三十行吗？这可是我的最高价了。
dialogue.tip: Could you do...? 是还价的礼貌句型；absolute top price 强调「不能再多了」。

alternatives.text: Would thirty do? That really is all I can spend.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thirty? You're having a laugh! I paid more than that for the film it came with.
dialogue.translation: 三十？你开玩笑吧！光它自带的胶卷我都不止花了这么多。
dialogue.tip: You're having a laugh 是英式「你在开玩笑吧」，表示还价太低；语气夸张但友好。

alternatives.text: Thirty? Don't be daft! I paid more for the film alone.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Alright, alright. How about we split the difference — thirty-two, and you throw in the strap?
dialogue.translation: 好好好。要不我们折中——三十二，你再把背带搭上？
dialogue.tip: split the difference 是「折中」的地道说法；throw in 表示「额外附送」。

alternatives.text: Let's meet in the middle — thirty-two, with the strap included.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（meet in the middle 也是折中）

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: The strap as well? You drive a hard bargain. Fine — thirty-two it is.
dialogue.translation: 连背带也要？你可真会砍价。行——就三十二吧。
dialogue.tip: drive a hard bargain 是英式习语「很会讲价」，多为称赞；thirty-two it is 表示「就这么定了」。

alternatives.text: The strap too? You're a canny negotiator. Deal — thirty-two.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（canny 是英式「精明的」）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant. While I'm here, how much are those vinyl records over there?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。既然来了，那边那些黑胶唱片多少钱？
dialogue.tip: while I'm here 自然引出下一个话题；vinyl 指黑胶唱片，是英式怀旧常用词。

alternatives.text: Lovely. What do you want for those records over there?
alternatives.meaning: 同义（What do you want for... 也是问价）

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They're two for a tenner, or six pounds each. Some are real classics.
dialogue.translation: 两张十镑，或者单张六镑。有些是真正的经典。
dialogue.tip: a tenner 是英式「十镑」；two for a tenner 是集市常见的促销说法。

alternatives.text: Ten pounds for two, or six each. A few of them are classics.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If I took four, could you do a bit better? I'd rather not haggle over every single one.
dialogue.translation: 如果我买四张，能再便宜点吗？我不想一张一张地讨价还价。
dialogue.tip: haggle 就是「讨价还价」；I'd rather not 表示「我宁愿不……」，语气委婉。

alternatives.text: Could I have four for a better price? I don't want to barter for each one.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（barter 也是讨价还价）

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Four for fifteen, and I'll chuck in this old basket for free.
dialogue.translation: 四张十五镑，我再免费搭上这个旧篮子。
dialogue.tip: chuck in 是英式口语「附带赠送」，比 throw in 更随意；for free 表示「免费」。

alternatives.text: Fifteen for the four, and you can have the basket thrown in.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's very kind. Let me have a quick look at the condition — any scratches?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。让我快速看一下成色——有划痕吗？
dialogue.tip: Let me have a quick look 是「我快速看一下」；scratch 指唱片表面的「划痕」。

alternatives.text: Lovely. Mind if I check them over — are they scratched at all?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A few light ones, nothing that'll jump. Honest, they play beautifully.
dialogue.translation: 有几道浅划痕，不至于跳针。说真的，播放效果很好。
dialogue.tip: jump 这里指唱片「跳针」；Honest 是英式口语「说真的、老实说」。

alternatives.text: Some faint marks, but they won't skip. They sound great, genuinely.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, I'll take the camera and the four records. How much altogether?
dialogue.translation: 好，我要相机和那四张唱片。一共多少钱？
dialogue.tip: How much altogether? 是问「总共多少」；altogether 表示「总共、合计」。

alternatives.text: Great, I'll have the camera and the four records. What's the total?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thirty-two plus fifteen... that's forty-seven, but I'll knock a couple off for you. Forty-five.
dialogue.translation: 三十二加十五……四十七，不过我给你抹个零。四十五。
dialogue.tip: knock ... off 在这里是「减去（价格）」；a couple off 指「去掉两三镑」。

alternatives.text: Forty-seven, but I'll let you have it for forty-five.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Forty-five, lovely. Do you take card, or is it cash only?
dialogue.translation: 四十五，很好。你们收卡吗，还是只收现金？
dialogue.tip: Do you take card? 是问支付方式；cash only 指「只收现金」。

alternatives.text: Forty-five, great. Can I pay by card, or do you prefer cash?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Cash is easiest, love, but I can do contactless if that's handy.
dialogue.translation: 现金最方便，朋友，不过你要是方便我也能非接触收款。
dialogue.tip: love 是英式友好称呼「亲爱的、朋友」；if that's handy 表示「如果那样方便的话」。

alternatives.text: Cash is simplest, love, but I've got a card machine if you'd rather tap.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Contactless is perfect, thanks. Here you go.
dialogue.translation: 非接触支付正好，谢谢。给你。
dialogue.tip: Here you go 是递钱、递东西时的地道用语，等于「给你」；perfect 表示「正合适」。

alternatives.text: Tap's ideal, cheers. Here you are.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（Here you are 同义）

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lovely. Let me wrap the camera up for you so it doesn't get knocked about.
dialogue.translation: 好嘞。我把相机给您包起来，免得被磕碰。
dialogue.tip: wrap up 是「包起来」；knocked about 是英式「被磕碰、被粗鲁对待」。

alternatives.text: Right you are. I'll wrap it so it doesn't get bashed around.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（bashed around 也是磕碰）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Much appreciated. Cheers for being so helpful — I'll definitely pop by again.
dialogue.translation: 非常感谢。谢谢你这么帮忙——我以后一定再来。
dialogue.tip: Much appreciated 是礼貌的「非常感谢」；pop by 是英式「顺便来访」。

alternatives.text: Thanks a lot. Really helpful — I'll be sure to come again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No worries at all. Enjoy the camera, and have a lovely day!
dialogue.translation: 完全不用客气。好好享受这台相机，祝你有美好的一天！
dialogue.tip: No worries 是英式「没关系、不客气」的高频回应；have a lovely day 是温暖得体的道别。

alternatives.text: Not a problem. Enjoy it, and have a good one!
alternatives.meaning: 同义（have a good one 是轻松道别）

exercises.question: 你想含蓄地表达「这有点贵」，最地道的说法是？
exercises.explanation: a bit steep 是英式含蓄说「有点贵」的地道说法，比直接说 too expensive 更得体、更符合英国砍价文化。

exercises.question: 卖家开价四十五镑，你想礼貌地问「还有讲价余地吗」，应说？
options: Is there any room for negotiation?
exercises.explanation: Is there any room for...? 是英式礼貌询问是否还有商量余地的万能句，语气委婉不冒犯。

exercises.question: 卖家说 You drive a hard bargain，他的意思是？
exercises.explanation: drive a hard bargain 是英式习语，指「很会砍价、寸步不让」，常带称赞意味。

exercises.question: 在旧货摊想买四张唱片并谈个好价，最自然的说法是？
options: If I took four, could you do a bit better?
exercises.explanation: If I took..., could you...? 用「多买换折扣」的思路谈价，地道又礼貌，远胜生硬的直接要低价。

scenes.title: 寒暄和赞美
scenes.description: 在英国聚会等社交场合从初次见面介绍、聊天气、聊周末与爱好，到赞美外表、能力与物品、得体接受并回应赞美的真实交流

patterns.note: 在聚会上找共同话题的开场白，一句就能打开话匣子，比 Where are you from 更适合社交场合。
天气是英式闲聊的万能话题，句尾加 isn't it 反问邀对方附和，瞬间拉近距离。
省略了 Do you have，简短又地道，是随口问对方安排的常用说法。

patterns.sentence: What do you get up to ___?
patterns.note: get up to 指「做、忙活」，问兴趣爱好时比 What's your hobby 自然得多。

patterns.sentence: I love your ___ — where did you get it?
patterns.meaning: 我很喜欢你的……——在哪儿买的？
patterns.note: 赞美加追问，既夸了对方又顺势延长话题，是英式寒暄里非常讨巧的一句。
英式得体回应赞美的万能句，填入不同内容既能礼貌接受，也能谦虚推让。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Alex, a friend of Sarah's.
dialogue.translation: 你好，我们好像还没见过。我叫 Alex，是 Sarah 的朋友。
dialogue.tip: I don't think we've met 是初次见面最自然的开场；a friend of Sarah's 用双重所有格点明共同认识的人。

alternatives.text: Hello, we haven't met, have we? I'm Alex.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ah, nice to meet you, Alex. I'm Tom. Sarah's mentioned you a few times.
dialogue.translation: 啊，很高兴认识你，Alex。我是 Tom。Sarah 提过你好几次呢。
dialogue.tip: Nice to meet you 是初次见面的固定语；mentioned you a few times 说明彼此有共同话题，拉近距离。

alternatives.text: Lovely to meet you. I'm Tom. Sarah's told me all about you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And you. Sorry, how do you know Sarah, if you don't mind me asking?
dialogue.translation: 我也很高兴认识你。不好意思，冒昧问一句，你是怎么认识 Sarah 的？
dialogue.tip: And you 是 Nice to meet you too 的简略；if you don't mind me asking 让打听变得格外礼貌。

words.word: if you don't mind me asking

alternatives.text: Sorry, how do you know Sarah?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We work together at the library. I'm a bit of a bookworm, if I'm honest.
dialogue.translation: 我们在图书馆一起共事。说实话，我算是个书虫。
dialogue.tip: a bit of a bookworm 是英式自嘲幽默；if I'm honest 意为「说实话」，常放句尾。

alternatives.text: We're colleagues at the library. I do love books, I suppose.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, how interesting. I'm more of an outdoors person myself, I'm afraid.
dialogue.translation: 哦，真有意思。不过我呢，恐怕更喜欢户外。
dialogue.tip: more of a... person 表示「更算是……的人」；I'm afraid 在英式英语里用来缓和语气。

alternatives.text: Really? I'm more into outdoor stuff myself.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Each to their own, as they say. So, is this your first time at one of Sarah's dos?
dialogue.translation: 正如那句话说的，各有所好。对了，这是你第一次参加 Sarah 的聚会吧？
dialogue.tip: each to their own 是英式「各有所好」；do 口语里指「聚会」，复数是 dos。

alternatives.text: Fair enough. Is this your first time at Sarah's party?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It is, yes. Blimey, it's absolutely freezing out there tonight, isn't it?
dialogue.translation: 是的，第一次。天哪，今晚外面真是冷得要命，对吧？
dialogue.tip: Blimey 是英式惊讶感叹词；freezing 夸张地说「冷极了」；句尾 isn't it 邀对方附和，是典型英式闲聊。

alternatives.text: Gosh, it's terribly cold out there, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It really is. You'd think it was January, not May. Typical British weather, eh?
dialogue.translation: 可不是嘛。还以为是正月呢，不是五月。典型的英国天气，是吧？
dialogue.tip: You'd think... 表示「还以为……」；Typical British weather 是英国人拿天气自嘲的固定说法。

alternatives.text: Tell me about it. I thought it was winter, not spring.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Honestly, I came dressed for summer and now I'm regretting it. Is it meant to brighten up?
dialogue.translation: 说实话，我穿得像来过夏天，现在后悔了。天气会转晴吗？
dialogue.tip: dressed for summer 指「按夏天的穿法」；brighten up 是英式「（天气）转晴」。

alternatives.text: I wish I'd brought a coat. Is it supposed to improve?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed for tomorrow. The forecast says it'll clear up by the weekend, hopefully.
dialogue.translation: 但愿明天走运。天气预报说周末前会放晴，希望如此吧。
dialogue.tip: Fingers crossed 是英式「祈好运」；clear up 指「雨停转晴」；hopefully 放句尾很口语。

alternatives.text: Let's hope so. They say it'll be fine by Saturday, all being well.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good, because we're planning a picnic on Saturday. Any plans for the weekend yourself?
dialogue.translation: 那就好，我们周六打算去野餐。你自己周末有什么安排吗？
dialogue.tip: Any plans for...? 是 Do you have any plans 的省略；yourself 在这里强调「你呢」。

alternatives.text: Lovely. We're having a picnic on Saturday. What about you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Quite a quiet one, I'm pleased to say. A bit of gardening and a lie-in, hopefully.
dialogue.translation: 挺安静的一个周末，我很开心。弄弄园艺，再睡个懒觉，希望如此。
dialogue.tip: quiet one 指「安静的一个周末」；lie-in 是英式「睡懒觉」，注意和 lie down 区分。

alternatives.text: Nothing much. A bit of gardening and a nice long lie-in.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. I could do with a lie-in myself — the kids have been up at six every morning.
dialogue.translation: 听起来不错。我也正想睡个懒觉——孩子们每天早上六点就醒了。
dialogue.tip: I could do with... 是英式「我正需要……」；have been up 用现在完成进行时强调持续。

alternatives.text: Sounds great. I really need a lie-in — the kids wake at six daily.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, dear. They're still young then. Ours are grown up now, and I miss the chaos, believe it or not.
dialogue.translation: 哎呀，那他们还小呢。我们的孩子都长大了，说也奇怪，我反倒想念那份热闹。
dialogue.tip: Oh, dear 表达同情；believe it or not 意为「信不信由你」，用来引出出人意料的坦白。

alternatives.text: Bless them. Ours are all grown up now — I actually miss the noise.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can imagine. So, you mentioned books — what do you get up to in your spare time, apart from reading?
dialogue.translation: 我能想象。对了，你刚提到书——除了读书，你空闲时间都做些什么？
dialogue.tip: get up to 是「做、忙活」的口语说法；apart from 表示「除……之外」，引出补充话题。

alternatives.text: Right. You love books — what else do you do in your free time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm keen on photography, mostly landscape stuff. I drag the wife along on walks for the light, you know.
dialogue.translation: 我挺喜欢摄影，主要是风景。我常拉着我太太去散步就为了那光线，你懂的。
dialogue.tip: keen on 是英式「喜欢、热衷」；drag... along 指「硬拉着一起去」；you know 是口语附加语。

alternatives.text: I'm into photography, landscapes mainly. I take my wife walking for the light.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, that's brilliant. I'm hopeless at photography, but I love a good walk myself. Do you mind if I have a look at your photos sometime?
dialogue.translation: 哦，太棒了。我摄影一窍不通，但我自己挺爱散步。你介意我改天看看你的照片吗？
dialogue.tip: hopeless at 是英式自嘲「对……毫无办法」；Do you mind if I... 是礼貌请求许可的句型。

alternatives.text: Lovely. I'm terrible at photos, but I love walking. Could I see your pictures sometime?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not at all — I'd be delighted. I'll show you a few over there when the queue dies down.
dialogue.translation: 完全不介意——我很乐意。等那边队伍散了，我给你看几张。
dialogue.tip: Not at all 是回应 Do you mind 的礼貌说法「一点也不介意」；dies down 指「平息、散去」。

alternatives.text: Of course, I'd love to. I'll show you some once it's quieter over there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Deal. Oh, before I forget — that jacket of yours looks really smart. Is it new?
dialogue.translation: 说定了。哦，差点忘了——你那件夹克看着真精神。新买的吗？
dialogue.tip: before I forget 是口语「差点忘了」；smart 在英式英语里是「时髦、整洁好看」，不是「聪明」。

alternatives.text: Right. By the way, your jacket looks great. Is it new?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you think? I've had it for ages, honestly. It was a bit of a bargain in the sale, though.
dialogue.translation: 真的吗？说实话我买好久了。不过打折时买的，挺划算。
