dialogue.tip: Do you think? 是英式受夸后的谦虚反问「真的吗」；a bit of a bargain 含蓄地说「挺划算」。

alternatives.text: You reckon? I've had it years. It was reduced, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, it suits you — very dapper. And you must be rather good at the photography, from what you say.
dialogue.translation: 真的很适合你——很帅气。而且听你这么说，摄影你一定相当在行。
dialogue.tip: dapper 指「衣着讲究的帅气」；must be rather good at 用 must 表推测，rather 是英式含蓄的「相当」。

alternatives.text: It really suits you. And I bet you're a great photographer.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's very kind of you, but honestly, anyone could do it. It's just knowing the light, really.
dialogue.translation: 你太客气了，不过说实话谁都能拍。就是懂点光线罢了。
dialogue.tip: That's very kind of you 是英式礼貌回应赞美；anyone could do it 是典型的谦虚说法。

alternatives.text: Kind of you to say so, but it's nothing special, really.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm not so sure. Anyway — that's a rather nice watch you're wearing. Is it something special?
dialogue.translation: 我可不这么认为。对了——你这块表挺好看的。有什么特别含义吗？
dialogue.tip: I'm not so sure 表示不认同对方的谦虚；rather nice 是英式「相当不错」，夸人又不夸张。

alternatives.text: I doubt it. Say, that's a lovely watch — is it special?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's nothing fancy, I'm afraid. Just an old one my dad gave me — still keeps perfect time, mind.
dialogue.translation: 恐怕没什么特别的。就是我爸给的一块旧表——不过走时还是准的。
dialogue.tip: nothing fancy 是英式「没什么特别、不高档」；mind 放句尾是「不过、留意」的口语用法。

alternatives.text: Nothing special, really. An old gift from my dad, but it's reliable.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, it's clearly been well looked after. I'd love to learn photography myself, actually.
dialogue.translation: 看得出来它被保养得很好。其实我自己也很想学摄影。
dialogue.tip: well looked after 是「保养得好」的被动表达；I'd love to... 表达愿望，比 I want 委婉。

alternatives.text: It's in great nick, though. I wouldn't mind learning photography myself.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（in great nick 英式「状态很好」）

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, you should — and frankly, your English is spot on already. Where did you pick it up?
dialogue.translation: 哦，你该学——而且坦白说，你的英语已经地道极了。你在哪儿学的？
dialogue.tip: spot on 是英式「完全正确、地道极了」；pick it up 在这里指「（偶然）学会」一门语言。

alternatives.text: You ought to. And your English is excellent — where did you learn it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, that's very kind of you, thank you. I'm flattered, honestly — I still make plenty of howlers.
dialogue.translation: 哦，你真是太客气了，谢谢。说实话我很荣幸——我还是常犯低级错误。
dialogue.tip: I'm flattered 是得体接受赞美；howlers 是英式口语「低级错误、大笑话」，自谦呼应含蓄传统。

alternatives.text: Thank you, that's lovely to hear. I still make lots of silly mistakes.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Come off it, you're far too modest. Anyway, here's my number so we can sort that photo session out.
dialogue.translation: 得了吧，你太谦虚了。对了，这是我的号码，好把看照片的事安排一下。
dialogue.tip: Come off it 是英式「得了吧、别开玩笑了」；sort... out 指「安排、处理」。

alternatives.text: Don't be silly, you're too modest. Here's my number — let's arrange that viewing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smashing, thanks. I'll give you a ring this week. Enjoy the rest of the evening!
dialogue.translation: 太好了，谢谢。我这周给你打电话。晚上余下的时间玩得开心！
dialogue.tip: smashing 是英式老派但常见的「极好」；give you a ring 是英式「给你打电话」。

alternatives.text: Brilliant, thanks. I'll call you this week. Have a great evening!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Cheers, you too. Don't be a stranger — pop into the library any time. Good night, Alex!
dialogue.translation: 谢谢，你也是。别生疏了——随时来图书馆找我。晚安，Alex！
dialogue.tip: cheers 在这里既是「谢谢」也是友好道别；don't be a stranger 是「常联系」；pop in 是「顺便来访」。

alternatives.text: Thanks, same to you. Do come and see me at the library. Good night!

exercises.question: 在聚会上想礼貌地问对方怎么认识主人，最合适的说法是？
options: How do you know the host?
How are you knowing the host?
exercises.explanation: How do you know...? 是询问对方如何认识某人的地道句型，配合 if you don't mind me asking 更礼貌。

exercises.question: 英式闲聊天气时说 It's absolutely freezing, ___? 横线处应填什么来邀对方附和？
exercises.explanation: 附加问句要与前句的 It's（it is）保持一致，故用 isn't it，这是英式闲聊拉近距离的常用方式。

exercises.question: 朋友夸你 Your English is spot on，这句话的意思是？
exercises.explanation: spot on 是英式口语「完全正确、地道极了」，用来称赞对方说得非常准确。

exercises.question: 别人夸你的夹克好看，最符合英式含蓄客气的回应是？
options: Do you think? I've had it for ages.
exercises.explanation: 英式受夸常先以 Do you think? 反问，再说 I've had it for ages 淡化，体现含蓄与谦虚。

scenes.title: 酒店入住
scenes.description: 在英国酒店从报预订、查证件、填登记卡、拿房卡，到报修换房、叫醒送餐、问早餐、投诉与延迟退房结账的真实交流

patterns.note: 到店报预订的地道开场；under 后面直接接姓名或预订名义，比 I booked a room 更自然。
一个句型搞定索要账单、叫醒、延迟退房和新房卡，比 Give me 礼貌百倍。
英式用 I'm afraid 缓和坏消息或投诉，礼貌又有分寸，不会显得咄咄逼人。
委婉提出请求或改动的高级句型，比 Can I 更客气，适合跟前台打交道。
报修或索取服务时的万能句，把具体问题填在 to 后面即可。
询问办理手续时的高频句，一个 need to 覆盖填表、查证件、付押金等各种流程。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. I've got a reservation for two nights under the name Harris.
dialogue.translation: 下午好。我以哈里斯的名字订了两晚。
dialogue.tip: I've got a reservation 是到店报预订的地道开场；under the name 指「以……姓名预订」。

alternatives.text: Afternoon. I've booked two nights under Harris.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Welcome. Could I see some photo ID, please?
dialogue.translation: 欢迎光临。能看一下您的带照片证件吗？
dialogue.tip: photo ID 指带照片的身份证件（护照、驾照等）；Could I see... 是礼貌查看证件的说法。

alternatives.text: Welcome. May I see your ID, please?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course, here's my passport.
dialogue.translation: 当然，这是我的护照。
dialogue.tip: here's 是 here is 的缩写，递东西时自然引出；passport 读英式 /ˈpɑːspɔːt/，注意词尾不卷舌。

alternatives.text: Sure, here you go.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. Just a moment while I bring up your booking... A twin room for two nights, is that right?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。稍等，我把您的预订调出来……两晚的双床房，对吗？
dialogue.tip: bring up 在这里指「在电脑上调出（记录）」；is that right? 是核实信息的常用尾句。

alternatives.text: One moment while I find your booking. A twin for two nights, correct?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Actually, it's a double — I booked it last week. Do you have the confirmation?
dialogue.translation: 其实是大床房——我上周订的。您有确认单吗？
dialogue.tip: double 指一张双人床的房间，与 twin（两张单人床）不同；Actually 用于礼貌纠正。

alternatives.text: It should be a double, actually. Did you get my confirmation?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ah, sorry, I've got you down as a twin. Let me have another look... Right, a double. My apologies.
dialogue.translation: 啊，抱歉，我把您登记成双床房了。我再看看……对，是大床房。很抱歉。
dialogue.tip: have you down as 是「把您记作……」的地道说法；My apologies 是较正式的道歉。

alternatives.text: Sorry, I had you as a twin. Let me check again — yes, a double. Sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No worries. So, do I need to fill in a registration card?
dialogue.translation: 没关系。那么，我需要填一张登记卡吗？
dialogue.tip: No worries 是英式高频的「没事儿」；fill in a form 是「填表」的地道搭配。

alternatives.text: That's fine. Do I have to fill out a registration card?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just this short form with your address and contact number. Here's a pen.
dialogue.translation: 就填这张简短的表格，写上地址和联系电话。给您笔。
dialogue.tip: contact number 是英式常说的「联系电话」；Here's a pen 是递东西时的自然表达。

alternatives.text: Just your address and phone number on this form. Here, take a pen.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right you are. Is there anything else, or am I all done?
dialogue.translation: 好的。还有别的事吗，还是我都办好了？
dialogue.tip: Right you are 是英式表示「好的、明白」的说法；all done 指「全部办妥」。

alternatives.text: Okay then. Anything else, or am I finished?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's everything. Here's your key card — room 512, on the fifth floor.
dialogue.translation: 都办好了。这是您的房卡——512 房间，在五楼。
dialogue.tip: key card 是酒店的「房卡」；英式说 on the fifth floor，floor 用英式 /flɔː(r)/。

alternatives.text: All set. Here's your card — room 512, fifth floor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brilliant. The lift's just over there, is it?
dialogue.translation: 太好了。电梯就在那边，对吧？
dialogue.tip: lift 是英式「电梯」（美式用 elevator）；句尾 is it? 是英式常见的附加疑问。

alternatives.text: Great. Is the lift just over there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's right. Take it to the fifth and it's on your left. Breakfast runs from seven to ten.
dialogue.translation: 对的。坐到五楼，房间在您左手边。早餐时间是七点到十点。
dialogue.tip: run 在这里表示「（早餐）供应时段为……」；Breakfast runs from... 是很地道的说法。

alternatives.text: Yes, fifth floor, on your left. Breakfast is served seven to ten.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, it's room 512. I'm afraid the shower's got no hot water.
dialogue.translation: 您好，我是 512 房。恐怕淋浴没有热水。
dialogue.tip: I'm afraid 用来缓和坏消息或抱怨，是英式礼貌的精髓；has got no 相当于 has no。

alternatives.text: Hi, room 512 here. Sorry, but there's no hot water in the shower.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh dear. I'm sorry about that. Let me send the maintenance man up straight away.
dialogue.translation: 哎呀，非常抱歉。我马上派维修工上去。
dialogue.tip: Oh dear 是英式表示同情或歉意的感叹；straight away 是「马上」的地道说法。

alternatives.text: Oh no, sorry. I'll get the maintenance chap up right away.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. Also, the air conditioning's making a funny noise — it's a bit distracting.
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。另外，空调发出奇怪的噪音——有点让人分心。
dialogue.tip: a funny noise 是英式口语「奇怪的响声」；a bit 缓和语气，避免听起来太挑剔。

alternatives.text: Thanks. The air con's making a strange noise, which is a bit annoying.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right, I'll get someone to look at that too. Would you mind if housekeeping popped in as well?
dialogue.translation: 好的，我也会派人去看看。您介意客房清洁也顺便过来一下吗？
dialogue.tip: pop in 是英式「顺便来一下」；Would you mind if...? 是极礼貌的请求许可句式。

alternatives.text: Okay, I'll send someone for that too. Is it alright if housekeeping comes in?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Actually, would it be possible to move rooms? It's just not quite what I expected.
dialogue.translation: 其实，有可能换间房吗？这房间跟我想的不太一样。
dialogue.tip: Would it be possible to...? 是委婉提出请求的万能句；not quite what I expected 含蓄表达不满。

alternatives.text: Could I change rooms, actually? It's not really what I had in mind.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, no problem at all. I can offer you room 608 — same rate, with a much nicer view.
dialogue.translation: 当然，完全没问题。我可以给您换到 608 房——同样的房价，视野好得多。
dialogue.tip: no problem at all 是英式爽快答应的说法；rate 指酒店的「房价」。

alternatives.text: Certainly. I can move you to 608 — same price, better view.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. I'll pop down and pick up the new key.
dialogue.translation: 听起来很好。我下去拿一下新房卡。
dialogue.tip: pop down 是英式「下去一趟」；pick up the key 指「领取钥匙」。

alternatives.text: Great, I'll come down and get the new card.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here you go. Sorry for the hassle — hope 608 is a bit better for you.
dialogue.translation: 给您。抱歉给您添麻烦了——希望 608 房能好一些。
dialogue.tip: hassle 是英式口语「麻烦事」；Sorry for the hassle 是服务场合常见的道歉。

alternatives.text: Here you are. Apologies for the trouble — hope the new room's better.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Morning, it's room 608. Could I arrange a wake-up call for tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: 早上好，我是 608 房。能安排一下明天的叫醒服务吗？
dialogue.tip: wake-up call 是酒店的「叫醒电话」；Could I arrange...? 是礼貌安排服务的句型。

alternatives.text: Morning, room 608. Could I get a wake-up call tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Certainly. And what time would you like it?
dialogue.translation: 当然。您希望几点叫醒？
dialogue.tip: would you like 比 do you want 礼貌得多；省略了 wake-up call，靠上下文补足。

alternatives.text: Of course. What time should I call you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Half past six, please. And could I order a bacon sandwich for breakfast in bed?
dialogue.translation: 六点半，谢谢。另外我能点一份培根三明治，送早餐到床上吗？
dialogue.tip: half past six 是英式读时间的方式（美式说 six thirty）；breakfast in bed 指「床上早餐」。

alternatives.text: Six thirty, please. Could I have a bacon sandwich brought up for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll put that down for seven. Anything to drink with it?
dialogue.translation: 当然。我记成七点。要配点喝的吗？
dialogue.tip: put that down 指「把（要求）记下来」；Anything to drink? 是点餐时的追加询问。

alternatives.text: Sure, I'll note that for seven. Would you like a drink with it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Just a pot of tea, please. Oh, and I'm afraid there was quite a bit of noise from next door last night.
dialogue.translation: 一壶茶就好。哦，还有，昨晚隔壁有点吵。
dialogue.tip: a pot of tea 是英式经典搭配；用 I'm afraid 缓和抱怨，quite a bit 表示「相当多」。

alternatives.text: Just tea, thanks. Also, sorry to say the people next door were noisy last night.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I do apologise. I'll make a note and have a word with them. Is there anything we can do to make up for it?
dialogue.translation: 非常抱歉。我会记下来，跟他们谈一谈。有什么我们可以弥补的吗？
dialogue.tip: I do apologise 用 do 加强道歉语气；have a word with 是英式「跟某人谈一谈」。

alternatives.text: I'm very sorry. I'll note it and speak to them. Can we do anything to compensate?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's fine, really — a decent night's sleep tonight should sort it. Could I have a late checkout at twelve?
dialogue.translation: 没事，真的——今晚睡个好觉就好了。我能延迟到十二点退房吗？
dialogue.tip: sort it 是英式口语「把事情解决好」；late checkout 指「延迟退房」。

alternatives.text: It's alright, honestly — I'll be fine after a good sleep. Could I check out at twelve?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me see... Yes, twelve is no problem. I've added it to your booking.
dialogue.translation: 我看看……可以，十二点没问题。我已经加到您的预订里了。
dialogue.tip: Let me see 是英式沉吟时的「我看看」；add it to your booking 指「记入预订记录」。

alternatives.text: Let me check... Yes, twelve's fine. I've noted it on your reservation.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. Right, I'm checking out now — could I have the bill, please?
dialogue.translation: 谢谢。对了，我现在要退房——能给我账单吗？
dialogue.tip: check out 是「退房」；英国说 bill，美式说 check，这里要用 bill。

alternatives.text: Cheers. I'm checking out now — could I have the bill, please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Breakfast was included in your rate, so it's just the two nights. Sign here and you're all set. Cheers!
dialogue.translation: 当然。早餐已包含在房价里，所以只算两晚房费。这里签字就办好了。谢谢！
dialogue.tip: all set 是「一切就绪」；cheers 在此是友好的道别与致谢，是英式服务的经典收尾。

alternatives.text: Sure. Breakfast is included, so it's just the room. Sign here and you're done. Cheers!

exercises.question: 到酒店报预订时，最地道的开场白是？
options: I've got a reservation under the name Harris.
exercises.explanation: I've got a reservation under... 是到店报预订最地道、最自然的说法，under 后接姓名。

exercises.question: 想礼貌地请酒店安排叫醒服务，应说？
options: Could I arrange a wake-up call for tomorrow?
exercises.explanation: Could I arrange...? 配合 wake-up call 是礼貌安排服务的标准句型。

exercises.question: 前台说 I've got you down as a twin，意思是？
options: 我把您登记成双床房了
exercises.explanation: have someone down as 是「把某人登记为……」的地道说法，这里指登记成 twin（双床房）。

exercises.question: 发现房间热水有问题，英式礼貌抱怨的说法是？
options: I'm afraid the shower's got no hot water.
exercises.explanation: I'm afraid 用来缓和坏消息，是英式礼貌抱怨的精髓，比直接指责得体得多。

scenes.title: 电脑运用
scenes.description: 在英国网站从浏览导航、注册填表、账号密码与验证码、网购支付到写邮件联系客服、处理弹窗错误提示的真实电脑操作交流

patterns.sentence: Could you tell me how to ___?
patterns.note: 问操作步骤的万能句，把动词短语填进去即可，比 How do I…? 更礼貌。

patterns.sentence: I'm having a bit of trouble ___.
patterns.note: a bit of trouble 是英式含蓄表达，不说 cannot，而说「有点小麻烦」，地道又有分寸。
确认是否必须做某事的常用句，填表、勾选条款、支付时都好用。
keep doing 表示「反复、一直」，描述弹窗或报错信息时特别地道。
have a look 是英式高频短语，表示「看一看」，比 I will check 自然得多。
can't seem to 是英式委婉说法，比 I cannot 柔和，适合描述操作上的小挫折。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi Sam, could you give me a hand? I'm having a bit of trouble with this site.
dialogue.translation: 嗨，山姆，能帮我个忙吗？我在这个网站上有点摸不着头脑。
dialogue.tip: give me a hand 是英式「帮个忙」的口语；a bit of trouble 是典型的英式含蓄说法。

alternatives.text: Hi Sam, can you help me? I'm struggling with this site.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. What are you trying to find on it?
dialogue.translation: 当然。你想在上面找什么？
dialogue.tip: Of course 是英式爽快答应；What are you trying to…? 询问对方目的很自然。

alternatives.text: Sure. What are you after?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to check the delivery details, but I can't seem to find the search bar.
dialogue.translation: 我想查一下配送信息，但好像找不到搜索栏。
dialogue.tip: can't seem to 是英式委婉说法，表示「似乎没法」；search bar 是网站搜索栏。

alternatives.text: I want to check delivery info, but where's the search?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's up at the top, next to the logo. Just have a look near the menu.
dialogue.translation: 在页面上方，标志旁边。在菜单附近找找看。
dialogue.tip: have a look 是英式「看一看」的高频短语；up at the top 指页面靠上位置。

alternatives.text: It's at the top beside the logo, near the menu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Got it. But there's a cookie pop-up covering the page — shall I close it?
dialogue.translation: 找到了。但现在有个 cookie 弹窗挡住了页面——我要关掉吗？
dialogue.tip: pop-up 指弹窗；shall I…? 是英式征求意见的常用句型。

alternatives.text: Right, but a cookie pop-up's blocking the page. Should I dismiss it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can reject them or just accept them. Either way, close it and carry on. Now, what are you after?
dialogue.translation: 你可以拒绝 cookie，或者干脆接受。不管怎样，关掉继续就行。现在你想做什么？
dialogue.tip: Either way 表示「无论哪种」；carry on 是英式「继续」；be after 是「想要」。

alternatives.text: Reject them or accept them — either's fine, then carry on.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to order something, but I haven't got an account. Where do I sign up?
dialogue.translation: 我想下单，但还没有账号。在哪里注册？
dialogue.tip: sign up 是「注册（账号）」的地道说法；haven't got 是英式口语的「没有」。

alternatives.text: I need to register first. Where's the sign-up link?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Click the Sign up button at the top right, then fill in your details.
dialogue.translation: 点右上角的注册按钮，然后填写你的资料。
dialogue.tip: fill in 是英式「填写（表格）」（美式常用 fill out）；at the top right 指右上角。

alternatives.text: Hit Register at the top right and complete the form.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: There's a little star next to some fields. What does that mean?
dialogue.translation: 有些字段旁边有个小星号。那是什么意思？
dialogue.tip: star 这里指 asterisk（星号）；be next to 表示「在……旁边」。

alternatives.text: Why do some fields have an asterisk next to them?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It means the field's required — you can't leave it blank. The rest are optional.
dialogue.translation: 表示这个字段是必填的——不能留空。其余的是选填。
dialogue.tip: required 指「必填的」，optional 指「选填的」；leave it blank 表示「留空」。

alternatives.text: The star means mandatory — you must fill it in. Others are optional.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, name and email are in. Now it wants a username — mine's taken.
dialogue.translation: 好，姓名和邮箱填好了。现在要用户名——我那个被占用了。
dialogue.tip: wants a username 是拟人化口语，指「要求填用户名」；taken 指「被占用了」。

alternatives.text: I've entered my name and email. It says my username's already in use.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Try adding a number at the end. And pick a password with a capital letter and a digit.
dialogue.translation: 试试在末尾加个数字。密码要包含一个大写字母和一个数字。
dialogue.tip: at the end 指「末尾」；capital letter 是大写字母，digit 是数字。

alternatives.text: Add a number to the end, and use a password with an uppercase letter and a number.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It keeps saying password too weak. I've tried three times — it's a bit frustrating.
dialogue.translation: 它一直提示密码太弱。我试了三次——有点让人烦。
dialogue.tip: keep doing 表示「一直、反复」；a bit frustrating 是英式含蓄抱怨。

alternatives.text: It says my password's too weak every time. I've tried three times already.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Try something longer with a symbol in it. Once it works, they'll email you a code.
dialogue.translation: 试试更长、带符号的。成功之后，他们会给你发一封含验证码的邮件。
dialogue.tip: once 在这里表示「一旦……之后」；symbol 指符号。

alternatives.text: Use a longer one with a symbol. Then they'll send you a code by email.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, the code's arrived. Where do I type the verification code?
dialogue.translation: 好，验证码到了。我在哪里输入验证码？
dialogue.tip: verification code 是「验证码」；arrived 这里指「到了、收到了」。

alternatives.text: The code's come through. Where should I enter it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In the box marked security code. Then tick the terms and conditions.
dialogue.translation: 在标着安全码的框里。然后勾选条款与条件。
dialogue.tip: marked 指「标注着」；tick 是英式「打勾」（美式常用 check）。

alternatives.text: In the box labelled security code. Enter it, then tick the terms and conditions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do I have to agree to the privacy policy as well? I never read these things.
dialogue.translation: 我也得同意隐私政策吗？我从来不读这些东西。
dialogue.tip: have to 表示「必须」；as well 放句尾表示「也」；privacy policy 是隐私政策。

alternatives.text: Must I accept the privacy policy too? I never bother reading it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You do, unfortunately. Just skim it — it's mostly about how they use your data.
dialogue.translation: unfortunately 你得同意。快速浏览一下就行——主要是讲他们怎么使用你的数据。
dialogue.tip: You do 是 You do have to 的省略；skim 是「略读」；data 指数据。

alternatives.text: Yes, you have to. Just skim through — it's about how they use your data.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sorted, I'm in. Let's have a look at what I want to buy.
dialogue.translation: 搞定了，我登录了。我们来看看我想买什么。
dialogue.tip: Sorted 是英式高频词，表示「搞定了」；have a look 再次出现，体现少词多用。

alternatives.text: Done, I'm logged in. Let's see what I want to buy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Go on, add it to your basket. Check it's in stock and pick your size first.
dialogue.translation: 来吧，加到购物车。先确认有货，再选尺码。
dialogue.tip: Go on 是英式鼓励「上吧、来吧」；add to basket 是英式「加入购物车」（美式常用 cart）。

alternatives.text: Add it to your cart. Make sure it's in stock and choose your size.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Done. I'm at the checkout now — it's asking for my postcode.
dialogue.translation: 好了。我现在在结账页面——它要我填邮政编码。
dialogue.tip: checkout 是「结账」；postcode 是英式「邮政编码」（美式常用 ZIP code）。

alternatives.text: Right, I'm checking out now — it wants my postcode for delivery.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Put it in and see the delivery options. Standard's cheaper; next day's a bit more.
dialogue.translation: 填进去看看配送选项。普通配送便宜些；次日达要贵一点。
dialogue.tip: Standard 这里指普通配送；a bit more 是英式「贵一点点」的含蓄说法。

alternatives.text: Enter it and compare the delivery options. Standard's cheaper, next day's dearer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll go for standard. Now the payment bit — where do I put my card number?
dialogue.translation: 我选普通配送。现在是支付环节——我把卡号填在哪儿？
dialogue.tip: I'll go for 是英式「我选……」；the payment bit 里的 bit 是英式口语「部分、环节」。

alternatives.text: I'll choose standard. Now for payment — where should I enter my card number?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In the card details section. You'll need the number, expiry date and the CVV on the back.
dialogue.translation: 在卡片信息栏。需要卡号、有效期和背面的安全码。
dialogue.tip: expiry date 是「有效期」；CVV 是卡背面常见的三位安全码。

alternatives.text: In the card details box — number, expiry date and the security code on the back.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do I need a separate billing address, or is my delivery one fine?
dialogue.translation: 我需要填不同的账单地址吗，还是用配送地址就行？
dialogue.tip: billing address 是「账单地址」；is … fine 表示「……可以吗」。

alternatives.text: Do I need a different billing address, or can I use my delivery address?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Use the same one — tick the box that says billing address same as delivery.
dialogue.translation: 用同一个就行——勾选那个「账单地址与配送地址相同」的框。
dialogue.tip: the same 表示「相同的」；same as delivery 是表单里的常见选项。

alternatives.text: Just use the same — tick 'billing address same as delivery'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, I've clicked Pay, but it says payment declined. What now?
dialogue.translation: 好，我点了支付，但它提示支付被拒。现在怎么办？
dialogue.tip: payment declined 是常见错误提示，指「支付被拒绝」；What now? 是「那怎么办」。

alternatives.text: I've pressed Pay but it says payment failed. What should I do?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Don't panic. Double-check the card number and try again. If not, use another card.
dialogue.translation: 别慌。再核对一下卡号，重试一次。不行的话，换张卡。
dialogue.tip: Don't panic 是安抚用语；double-check 是「仔细核对」；if not 是「如果不行」。

alternatives.text: No worries. Check the card number and retry. Otherwise, try a different card.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It worked — I've got an order number and a confirmation email. But they've sent the wrong size, so I'll email customer services.
dialogue.translation: 成功了——我拿到了订单号和确认邮件。但他们发错了尺码，所以我要给客服发邮件。
dialogue.tip: It worked 表示「成了、起作用了」；customer services 是英式「客服」常用说法。

alternatives.text: It went through — order number and confirmation email. But it's the wrong size, so I'll write to customer services.
alternatives.meaning: 同义（go through = 成功完成）

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good. Open the live chat or send that email — quote your order number and ask for a replacement. Give me a shout if you're stuck.
dialogue.translation: 好。打开在线客服或发那封邮件——报上订单号，要求换货。要是卡住了就叫我。
dialogue.tip: quote your order number 指「报出订单号」；give me a shout 是英式「叫我、联系我」。

alternatives.text: Send that email — include your order number and ask for a replacement. Let me know if you're stuck.

exercises.question: 你想礼貌地请朋友教你注册账号，最合适的说法是？
options: Could you tell me how to create an account?
exercises.explanation: Could you tell me how to…? 是询问操作步骤的礼貌万能句，后面直接接动词短语。

exercises.question: 网站反复提示密码太弱，最地道的表达是？
options: It says weak password many times.
It keeps saying password too weak.
exercises.explanation: keep doing 表示「反复、一直」，It keeps saying… 用来描述反复出现的弹窗或报错最地道。

exercises.question: 表单里某字段旁有星号（asterisk），通常表示？
exercises.explanation: 星号表示必填（required），不能留空；选填的字段是 optional。

exercises.question: 支付时页面提示 payment declined，意思是？
exercises.explanation: declined 意为「被拒绝」，payment declined 即支付被拒，通常需要核对卡号或换卡重试。
